候选人.s: 他是那个职位最有希望的候选人。
候选人.p: Tā shì nàge zhíwèi zuì yǒuxīwàng de hòuxuǎnrén.

统治.s: 统治一个国家并不简单。
统治.e: To govern a country is no easy job.

享有.s: 他享有私人教学的特权。
享有.p: Tā xiǎngyǒu sīrén jiāoxué de tèquán.

国民.s: 总统在电视上对国民讲话。
国民.p: Zǒngtǒng zài diànshì shàng duì guómín jiǎnghuà.

告知.s: 我们应该把那件事情告知他们。
告知.p: Wǒmen yīnggāi bǎ nà jiàn shìqing gàozhī tāmen.

准则.s: 接受对方的准则就是给予他权力。

短暂.p: Wǒ zhīdào shēngmìng shì duǎnzàn de.

检察.s: 检察官问了我一个引导性的问题。

嫩.s: 你觉得汤姆是不是太嫩了？

贿赂.e: The mayor denied having taken a bribe.

论证.s: 这位老师用试验论证了这个想法。
论证.p: Zhèwèi lǎoshī yòng shìyàn lùnzhèng le zhège xiǎngfǎ.
论证.e: The teacher demonstrated the idea with an experiment.

本事.s: 她真的有本事让别人做她想做的事。
本事.p: Tā zhēnde yǒuběnshi ràng biéren zuò tā xiǎng zuò de shì.
本事.e: She has a real knack for getting people to do what she wants.

数据库.s: 这是个非常好的数据库。
数据库.p: Zhè shì gè fēicháng hǎo de shùjùkù.
数据库.e: This is a very good data base.

见证.s: 汤姆见证了所有发生的事情。
见证.p: Tāngmǔ jiànzhèng le suǒyǒu fāshēng de shìqing.

威力.s: 一名伟大的战士威力显著，无需抵死奋战。
威力.p: Yì míng wěidà de zhànshì wēilì xiǎnzhù, wúxū dǐ sǐ fènzhàn.
威力.e: A great warrior radiates strength. He doesn't have to fight to the death.

使命.p: Tā wánchéng le tā de shǐmìng.

均衡.s: 这些东西构成了一顿营养均衡的饭。
均衡.p: Zhèxiē dōngxī gòuchéng le yí dùn yíngyǎng jūnhéng de fàn.
均衡.e: These things constitute a balanced meal.

喜悦.s: 她的眼睛闪烁着喜悦的光芒。
喜悦.p: Tā de yǎnjing shǎnshuò zhe xǐyuè de guāngmáng.
喜悦.e: Her eyes were shining with joy.

分歧.s: 是在这点上我们的意见有分歧。
分歧.p: Shì zài zhè diǎn shàng wǒmen de yìjiàn yǒu fēnqí.
分歧.e: It is on this point that our opinions differ.

言论.s: 世上最好的事情，就是言论自由。
言论.p: Shìshàng zuìhǎo de shìqing, jiùshì yánlùnzìyóu.
言论.e: The best thing in the world is freedom of speech.

问候.e: Say hello to your sister for me.

念头.s: 打消这种幼稚的念头吧。
念头.p: Dǎxiāo zhèzhǒng yòuzhì de niàntou ba.
念头.e: Get rid of those kinds of naive ideas.

过头.s: 政府的开支有些过头了。
过头.p: Zhèngfǔ de kāizhī yǒuxiē guòtóu le.
过头.e: The government's expenditures are a bit excessive.

敬.s: 幼儿园的老师告诉小朋友们要互敬互爱。
敬.p: Yòuéryuán de lǎoshī gàosù xiǎopéngyǒu men yào hù jìng hù ài.
敬.e: The teacher of the kindergarten told the pupils to respect, and cherish each other.

幸好.s: 幸好你提醒我，不然我永远记不起来了。
幸好.p: Xìnghǎo nǐ tíxǐng wǒ, bùrán wǒ yǒngyuǎn jì bù qǐlai le.
幸好.e: Good that you told me, otherwise I would never have remembered it.

遏制.s: 我无法遏制住我的怒火。
遏制.p: Wǒ wúfǎ èzhì zhù wǒ de nùhuǒ.

致力于.s: 从他大学毕业后，他就一直致力于原子能的研究。
致力于.p: Cóng tā dàxué bìyè hòu, tā jiù yìzhí zhìlìyú yuánzǐnéng de yánjiū.
致力于.e: He has been devoted to the study of atomic energy ever since he graduated from the university.

阵地.s: 士兵们撤离了他们的阵地。
阵地.p: Shìbīng men chèlí le tāmen de zhèndì.
阵地.e: The soldiers retreated from their positions.

意愿.s: 我不是个意愿自由主义着。
意愿.p: Wǒ búshì gè yìyuàn zìyóuzhǔyì zhe.

团伙.s: 该名青年将少女从流氓团伙中救了出来。
团伙.p: Gāi míng qīngnián jiàng shàonǚ cóng liúmáng tuánhuǒ zhōng jiù le chūlái.
团伙.e: The young man saved the girl from a bunch of hoodlums.

宠.p: Wǒ yào yì zhǐ chǒng lǎohǔ.

光芒.s: 我在这个世界散发着自己的光芒。
光芒.p: Wǒ zài zhège shìjiè sànfā zhe zìjǐ de guāngmáng.
光芒.e: I shine light in the world.

炖.s: 汤姆往炖菜里加了西兰花。
炖.p: Tāngmǔ wǎng dùn cài Lǐjiā le xīlánhuā.
炖.e: Tom added broccoli to the stew.

保守.e: How many secrets can you keep?

裂.s: 我的网球拍裂了，所以我把它拿去修了。
裂.p: Wǒ de wǎngqiú pāi liè le, suǒyǐ wǒ bǎ tā ná qù xiū le.
裂.e: There was a crack in my tennis racket, so I sent it out to be repaired.

垫.s: 有垫布与拉链的帐篷可以做到防虫密闭。
垫.p: Yǒu diàn bù yǔ lāliàn de zhàngpeng kěyǐ zuòdào fáng chóng mìbì.
垫.e: A tent with a floor and a zipper is bug tight.

垂.s: 她把头垂在她母亲的肩上。
垂.p: Tā bǎtóu chuí zài tā mǔqīn de jiān shàng.
垂.e: She rested her head on her mother's shoulder.

好似.s: 他的失败好似和他的性格有什么关系。
好似.p: Tā de shībài hǎosì hé tā de xìnggé yǒu shénme guānxi.
好似.e: His failure seems to have something to do with his character.

萝卜.p: Bǎ húluóbo fàng zài guō lǐ.
萝卜.e: Put the carrots in the pot.

捂.s: 她捂着嘴，笑得跟个小女生似的。
捂.p: Tā wǔ zhe zuǐ, xiào de gēn gè xiǎonǚ shēng shìde.
捂.e: She laughed the way schoolgirls do, with her hand over her mouth.

耗.p: Wǒ bǎ lǚfèi hào guāng le.
耗.e: I have run out of my traveling expenses.

人品.e: He's a man of outstanding character.

边界.s: 我很讨厌没有边界感的人。
边界.p: Wǒ hěn tǎoyàn méiyǒu biānjiè gǎn de rén.
边界.e: I don't like people who have no sense of boundaries.

入手.s: 我们从根本问题入手吧。
入手.p: Wǒmen cóng gēnběn wèntí rùshǒu ba.

包围.s: 特种部队包围了建筑物。

悲哀.s: 她的眼神里充满了悲哀。
悲哀.p: Tā de yǎnshén lǐ chōngmǎn le bēiāi.
悲哀.e: Her eyes were full of sadness.

眼下.s: 眼下我不得不和我朋友同住这间房间。
眼下.p: Yǎnxià wǒ bùdébù hé wǒ péngyou tóng zhù zhè jiān fángjiān.
眼下.e: I have to share this room with my friend at present.

翘.s: 玛丽翘着二郎腿坐在沙发上。
翘.p: Mǎlì qiào zhe èrlángtuǐ zuò zài shāfā shàng.
翘.e: Mary sat cross-legged on the couch.

宁愿.s: 我宁愿饿着也不吃这个。
宁愿.p: Wǒ nìngyuàn è zhe yě bù chī zhège.
宁愿.e: I'd rather go hungry than eat this.

极限.s: 他的耐心已经到了极限。
极限.p: Tā de nàixīn yǐjīng dàoliǎo jíxiàn.

视线.p: Niǎor jiànjiàn fēi lí le shìxiàn.
视线.e: The bird flew away and was lost to sight.

提议.e: Your proposal is worthy of being considered.

谴责.s: 议员受到了议会道德委员会的谴责。
谴责.p: Yìyuán shòudào le yìhuì dàodé wěiyuánhuì de qiǎnzé.
谴责.e: The senator was censured by the congressional ethics committee.

蔓延.s: 这些措施可以预防疾病蔓延。
蔓延.p: Zhèxiē cuòshī kěyǐ yùfáng jíbìng mànyán.
蔓延.e: These measures can prevent the disease from spreading.

投放.s: 第一颗原子弹投放到日本。
投放.p: Dìyī kē yuánzǐdàn tóufàng dào Rìběn.
投放.e: The first atomic bomb was dropped on Japan.

寺.p: Zhè liàng chē qù jìng ān sì ma?
寺.e: Does this car go to Jingan temple?

降临.p: Búxìng jiànglín dào tā de tóushàng.

上游.e: The upper reaches of the river are very beautiful.

规章.s: 我们想修改学校的规章制度。
规章.p: Wǒmen xiǎng xiūgǎi xuéxiào de guīzhāngzhìdù.
规章.e: We want to modify the regulations of our school.

邪恶.s: 没有什么能阻碍我邪恶的计划。
邪恶.p: Méiyǒushénme néng zǔài wǒ xiéè de jìhuà.
邪恶.e: Nothing will hinder my malicious plan.

流氓.s: 该名青年将少女从流氓团伙中救了出来。
流氓.p: Gāi míng qīngnián jiàng shàonǚ cóng liúmáng tuánhuǒ zhōng jiù le chūlái.
流氓.e: The young man saved the girl from a bunch of hoodlums.

侦查.p: Tā shì gè lǎoliàn de zhēnchá yuán.

激光.s: 这个诊所正在做激光手术。
激光.p: Zhège zhěnsuǒ zhèngzài zuò jīguāng shǒushù.
激光.e: This clinic is doing laser surgery.

驱动.p: Zhè liàng chē kào tiānránqì qūdòng.
驱动.e: This car runs on natural gas.

勾.s: 孩子的新毛衣上勾了一个洞。
勾.p: Háizi de xīn máoyī shàng gōu le yìge dòng.
勾.e: The child has picked a hole in his new jumper.

子弹.s: 警察会让你去找子弹的。
子弹.p: Jǐngchá huì ràng nǐ qù zhǎo zǐdàn de.
子弹.e: The police will get you to find the bullets.

竞技.s: 马德里竞技遭遇失败后，很明显大家都很生气。
竞技.p: Mǎdélǐ jìngjì zāoyù shībài hòu, hěn míngxiǎn dàjiā dōu hěn shēngqì.
竞技.e: It was evident that everyone was upset when Atletico Madrid suffered defeat.

税务.s: 艾伦很幸运地考过了税务师考试。
税务.p: Ài lún hěn xìngyùn de kǎoguò le shuìwù shī kǎoshì.
税务.e: Allan was lucky and passed the tax accountant examination.

拯救.s: 只有和平能够拯救世界。
拯救.e: Only peace can save the world.

扛.p: Wǒ bǎ hézi káng zài jiān shàng.
扛.e: I carried the box on my shoulder.

时段.e: Every day I work different hours.

萎缩.s: 他的腿部肌肉在他卧床不起的七个月中萎缩了。
萎缩.p: Tā de tuǐbù jīròu zài tā wòchuáng bù qǐ de qī gè yuèzhōng wěisuō le.
萎缩.e: The muscles in his legs had atrophied during the seven months he was bedridden.

老人家.e: May I ask how old you are?

着重.s: 大自然在我们的生活中扮演着重要的角色。
着重.p: Dàzìrán zài wǒmen de shēnghuó zhōng bànyǎn zhuózhòng yào de juésè.
着重.e: Nature plays an important role in our life.

理智.e: He finally came to his senses.

预警.s: 气象局发布了暴雨红色预警。
预警.p: Qìxiàngjú fābù le bàoyǔ hóngsè yùjǐng.
预警.e: The meteorological bureau has issued a red rainstorm alert.

冷漠.s: 你对待身边的人太冷漠了。
冷漠.p: Nǐ duìdài shēnbiān de rén tài lěngmò le.
冷漠.e: You are too indifferent to those around you.

流浪.s: 我一辈子都是个流浪者。
流浪.p: Wǒ yíbèizi dōu shì gè liúlàngzhě.

报复.s: 他对杀父凶手进行了报复。
报复.p: Tā duì shā fù xiōngshǒu jìnxíng le bàofù.
报复.e: He avenged the murder of his father.

地步.s: 他还没有傻到相信这个故事的地步。
地步.p: Tā hái méiyǒu shǎ dào xiāngxìn zhège gùshì de dìbù.
地步.e: He is not such a fool as to believe that story.

癌症.s: 他儿子小时候就死于癌症了。
癌症.p: Tā érzi xiǎoshíhou jiù sǐ yú áizhèng le.
癌症.e: His son died from cancer at a young age.

边境.s: 我的朋友住在瑞士与德国边境附近。
边境.p: Wǒ de péngyou zhù zài Ruìshì yǔ Déguó biānjìng fùjìn.
边境.e: My friend lives near the Swiss German border.

标签.s: 箱子的内容在标签上面写着。
标签.p: Xiāngzi de nèiróng zài biāoqiān shàngmiàn xiě zhe.
标签.e: The contents of the box are listed on the label.

何况.s: 宝宝连走都不会，更何况是跑。
何况.p: Bǎobao lián zǒu dōu búhuì, gēng hékuàng shì pǎo.
何况.e: The baby can't walk, much less run.

取胜.s: 单凭力量不能保证取胜。
取胜.p: Dān píng lìliang bùnéng bǎozhèng qǔshèng.
取胜.e: Relying on strength alone cannot guarantee victory.

版权.p: Nà běn shū réng shòu bǎnquán bǎohù.

主权.s: 中国主张钓鱼岛的主权。
主权.e: China is an advocate for the Diaoyu Islands' sovereignty.

不容.s: 英语不容易，但很有意思。
不容.p: Yīngyǔ bùróng yì, dàn hěn yǒuyìsi.
不容.e: English is not easy, but it is interesting.

陈述.s: 我想撤回我之前的陈述。
陈述.p: Wǒ xiǎng chèhuí wǒ zhīqián de chénshù.
陈述.e: I would like to retract my previous statement.

宽松.s: 她穿了一件宽松的长外套。
宽松.p: Tā chuān le yí jiàn kuānsōng de cháng wàitào.
宽松.e: She wore a long, loose coat.

配件.s: 这家工厂生产汽车配件。
配件.p: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng shēngchǎn qìchē pèijiàn.

温泉.e: There are a lot of hot springs in Japan.

领土.p: Jūnduì zhànlǐng le zhěng piàn lǐngtǔ.
领土.e: The armed forces occupied the entire territory.

狂欢.s: 不是所有巴西人都喜欢狂欢节。
狂欢.p: Búshì suǒyǒu Bāxī rén dōu xǐhuan kuánghuānjié.

大局.e: He was master of the situation.

退役.s: 汤姆是一个越军退役军人。
退役.p: Tāngmǔ shì yìge yuè jūn tuìyì jūnrén.

必定.p: Tā de zhèngquán bìdìng huì bēngkuì.
必定.e: His regime is bound to collapse.

压抑.s: 汤姆没法压抑自己的怒火了。
压抑.p: Tāngmǔ méifǎ yāyì zìjǐ de nùhuǒ le.
压抑.e: Tom couldn't hold back his anger.

传闻.s: 传闻这附近有些脏东西。
传闻.p: Chuánwén zhè fùjìn yǒuxiē zāng dōngxī.
传闻.e: There are rumors that some evil spirits linger around here.

协定.e: We have to come to some agreement.

罩.s: 无边的白雪罩住了目所能及的一切。
罩.p: Wúbiān de báixuě zhào zhù le mù suǒnéng jí de yíqiè.
罩.e: Boundless snow covered all that could be seen.

过剩.s: 由于产量过剩，卷心菜的价格下降了。
过剩.p: Yóuyú chǎnliàng guòshèng, juǎnxīncài de jiàgé xiàjiàng le.
过剩.e: The price of cabbage fell because of overproduction.

残忍.s: 他跟她说这样的话真是太残忍了。
残忍.p: Tā gēn tā shuō zhèyàng dehuà zhēnshi tài cánrěn le.
残忍.e: It is cruel of him to say such things to her.

旗帜.e: A flag is a national symbol.

苦笑.s: 中松为自己的愚蠢问题苦笑。
苦笑.p: Zhōng sōng wèi zìjǐ de yúchǔn wèntí kǔxiào.
苦笑.e: Nakamatsu smiled bitterly at his own stupid question.

干涉.p: Nǐ gǎn gānshè wǒ de shì shì shì!
干涉.e: Don't you dare to meddle with my affairs.

宁静.s: 奈良是一个宁静而美丽的城市。
宁静.p: Nàiliáng shì yìge níngjìng ér měilì de chéngshì.
宁静.e: Nara is a quiet and beautiful city.

立体.s: 往立体声音响上放一枚唱片。
立体.p: Wǎng lìtǐshēng yīnxiǎng shàng fàng yì méi chàngpiàn.
立体.e: Put a record on the stereo.

把手.s: 我得把手表调快两分钟。
把手.p: Wǒ de bǎshǒu biǎo diào kuài liǎng fēnzhōng.
把手.e: I need to set my watch to two minutes faster.

沾.s: 衣服沾上油渍怎么清洗？
沾.p: Yīfu zhān shàng yóuzì zěnme qīngxǐ?
沾.e: How do you clean oil stains off clothes?

放射.p: Tā shì yìge fàngshè kē yīshēng.

不惜.s: 我们应该不惜代价避免战争。
不惜.p: Wǒmen yīnggāi bùxī dàijià bìmiǎn zhànzhēng.
不惜.e: We must avoid war at all cost.

海峡.s: 这个海峡对游艇来说太窄了。
海峡.p: Zhège hǎixiá duì yóutǐng lái shuō tài zhǎi le.
海峡.e: The straits were too narrow for the cruise ship.

平面.s: 首先，因为海水变热时膨胀，海平面可能提高。
平面.p: Shǒuxiān, yīnwèi hǎishuǐ biàn rè shí péngzhàng, hǎipíngmiàn kěnéng tígāo.
平面.e: First of all, the level of the ocean could rise, because ocean water expands as it grows warmer.

无论如何.s: 她的住址无论如何也想不起来。
无论如何.p: Tā de zhùzhǐ wúlùnrúhé yě xiǎng bù qǐlai.
无论如何.e: I can't remember her address no matter how much I try.

壮.e: Tom is tall and likewise strong.

适时.s: 听说适时地补充水分可以预防中暑。
适时.p: Tīngshuō shìshí de bǔchōng shuǐfèn kěyǐ yùfáng zhòngshǔ.
适时.e: I hear that keeping yourself hydrated at appropriate times can help prevent heatstroke.

麻醉.s: 在麻醉剂的作用下，他昏了过去。
麻醉.p: Zài mázuìjì de zuòyòng xià, tā hūn le guòqù.
麻醉.e: He lost consciousness under the influence of the anesthetic.

胎儿.s: 胎盘的角色是滋养胎儿。
胎儿.p: Tāipán de juésè shì zīyǎng tāiér.
胎儿.e: The role of the placenta is to nourish the foetus.

缠.s: 护士轻柔地给我的头缠上绷带。
缠.p: Hùshi qīngróu de gěi wǒ de tóu chán shàng bēngdài.
缠.e: The nurse gently put a bandage around my head.

高贵.s: 你妹妹看上去那么高贵，就像是个公主一样。
高贵.p: Nǐ mèimei kànshangqu nàme gāoguì, jiù xiàng shì gè gōngzhǔ yíyàng.
高贵.e: Your sister looks as noble as if she were a princess.

枕.s: 她把头枕在母亲的肩膀上。
枕.p: Tā bǎtóu zhěn zài mǔqīn de jiānbǎng shàng.
枕.e: She rested her head on her mother's shoulder.

终究.s: 这终究不是一个很好主意
终究.p: Zhè zhōngjiū búshì yìge hěn hǎo zhǔyi
终究.e: This wasn't such a good idea after all.

嘴唇.p: Nǐ de zuǐchún shàng yǒu dōngxī.
嘴唇.e: You've got something on your lip.

劈.p: Luàn fāshì huì zāo léi pī de.
劈.e: If you swear reckless oaths, lightning will strike you.

搅.p: Tā yòng cháchí jiǎo tā de kāfēi.
搅.e: She stirred her coffee with a teaspoon.

征服.p: Wǒ lái, wǒ jiàn, wǒ zhēngfú.
征服.e: I came, I saw, I conquered.

仇.s: 他杀死了他，为死去的父亲报了仇。
仇.p: Tāshā sǐ le tā, wèi sǐqù de fùqīn bào le chóu.
仇.e: He killed him to avenge his dead father.

留意.e: You must keep your eyes open.

游行.s: 我要参加一个示威游行。
游行.e: I'm going to join a demonstration.

简洁.s: 他的评论简洁且击中要害。
简洁.p: Tā de pínglùn jiǎnjié qiě jīzhòng yàohài.
简洁.e: His comment was concise and to the point.

筑.s: 请在建筑的入口处等我。
筑.p: Qǐng zàijiàn zhù de rùkǒu chù děng wǒ.
筑.e: Please wait for me at the entrance of the building.

重重.s: 虽然困难重重，他还是完成了这个任务。
重重.p: Suīrán kùnnan chóngchóng, tā háishi wánchéng le zhège rènwu.
重重.e: Despite a lot of difficulties, he still completed the task.

生效.p: Yí xiàng xīn de fǎlǜ shēngxiào le.
生效.e: A new law has come into existence.

信誉.p: Zhè huì sǔnhài wǒmen de xìnyù.

扩建.s: 西面大楼的扩建在研究中。
扩建.p: Xīmiàn dàlóu de kuòjiàn zài yánjiū zhōng.
扩建.e: The expansion of the building's west end is being studied.

祈祷.s: 我正在我的房间里祈祷。
祈祷.p: Wǒ zhèngzài wǒ de fángjiān lǐ qídǎo.
祈祷.e: I am praying in my room.

失落.s: 即便是被同学嘲笑，那个男孩也不会感到失落。
失落.p: Jíbiàn shì bèi tóngxué cháoxiào, nàge nánhái yě búhuì gǎndào shīluò.
失落.e: The boy was not upset, even after being laughed at by his classmates.

攀升.s: 事实上，价格每个星期都在攀升。
攀升.p: Shìshíshàng, jiàgé měige xīngqī dōu zài pānshēng.
攀升.e: As it is, prices are going up every week.

阐述.s: 他简单地阐述了他的理由。
阐述.p: Tā jiǎndān de chǎnshù le tā de lǐyóu.
阐述.e: He gave his reasons in brief.

没收.p: Hǎojiǔ mòshōu dào nǐ de láixìn.
没收.e: I haven't heard from you for a long time.

上诉.s: 被告会向上级法院上诉。
上诉.p: Bèigào huì xiàngshàng jí fǎyuàn shàngsù.
上诉.e: The defendant will appeal to a higher court.

违背.p: Nǐ bùgāi wéibèi nǐ de nuòyán.

恶性.s: 回答把我们带入了一个恶性循环。
恶性.p: Huídá bǎ wǒmen dài rù le yìge èxìngxúnhuán.
恶性.e: The answer leads us to a vicious circle.

无不.e: All good things must come to an end.

虽说.s: 虽说是高学历，也未必就有教养。
虽说.p: Suīshuō shì gāoxuélì, yě wèibì jiù yǒu jiàoyǎng.
虽说.e: A good education doesn't imply a good upbringing.

贵族.s: 总体来说，贵族受到税收的影响微乎其微。
贵族.p: Zǒngtǐ lái shuō, guìzú shòudào shuìshōu de yǐngxiǎng wēihūqíwēi.
贵族.e: Generally speaking, nobles were only very slightly affected by taxes.

会场.s: 会场内，掌声、哨声、喊声、笑声乱成了一锅粥。
会场.p: Huìchǎng nèi, zhǎngshēng, shào shēng, hǎnshēng, xiàoshēng luàn chéngle yìguōzhōu.
会场.e: Inside the venue, sounds of clapping, whistling, yelling, laughing blended together.

公式.s: 你知道这些公式是从哪里来的吗？
公式.p: Nǐ zhīdào zhèxiē gōngshì shì cóng nǎlǐ lái de ma?
公式.e: Do you know where these equations come from?

来回.s: 你们学校真好，还帮你们报销来回的机票。
来回.p: Nǐmen xuéxiào zhēn hǎo, hái bāng nǐmen bàoxiāo láihuí de jīpiào.
来回.e: Your school is so kind to reimburse you for the return airfare.

轻微.s: 日程表只受到了这次延误的轻微影响。
轻微.p: Rìchéngbiǎo zhǐ shòudào le zhè cì yánwù de qīngwēi yǐngxiǎng.
轻微.e: The schedule is only slightly affected by this delay.

灶.s: 他妻子在灶旁做饭，而他在坐着读书。
灶.p: Tā qīzǐ zài zào páng zuòfàn, ér tā zài zuò zhe dúshū.
灶.e: He sat down and read while his wife was cooking by the fire.

登场.s: 这部漫画登场的人物全是少女。
登场.p: Zhè bù mànhuà dēngchǎng de rénwù quán shì shàonǚ.
登场.e: All the characters of this comic are girls.

前夕.e: He was very anxious on the eve of the exam.

档次.s: 我们去一家档次再高点儿的餐厅怎么样？
档次.p: Wǒmen qù yìjiā dàngcì zài gāo diǎnr de cāntīng zěnmeyàng?
档次.e: Shall we go to a little more upscale restaurant?

下手.s: 先下手为强，后下手遭殃。
下手.e: Get them before they get us.

演变.s: 起初的天灾迅速演变为了人祸。
演变.p: Qǐchū de tiānzāi xùnsù yǎnbiàn wèile rénhuò.
演变.e: What was at first a natural disaster rapidly became a man-made debacle.

叼.s: 爷爷叼着烟管跟我说话。
叼.p: Yéye diāo zhe yānguǎn gēn wǒ shuōhuà.
叼.e: Grandfather talked to me with a pipe in his mouth.

恶意.e: There was no malice intended in what she said.

线条.p: Tā yǒu míngxiǎn de jīròu xiàntiáo.

战役.s: 很多士兵在这场战役中严重受伤。
战役.p: Hěn duōshì bīng zài zhè chǎng zhànyì zhōng yánzhòng shòushāng.
战役.e: Many soldiers suffered terrible wounds in the battle.

压迫.s: 这个国家的政府压迫人民。
压迫.p: Zhège guójiā de zhèngfǔ yāpò rénmín.
压迫.e: The government of this country oppresses its people.

柴油.s: 这个取暖装置用柴油作为燃料。
柴油.p: Zhège qǔnuǎn zhuāngzhì yòng cháiyóu zuòwéi ránliào.
柴油.e: This heating equipment uses diesel as fuel.

掩饰.p: Wǒ bùnéng yǎnshì wǒ de xīnqíng.

懒得.s: 我懒得整理我的头发，所以我看起来就像个懒汉。
懒得.p: Wǒ lǎnde zhěnglǐ wǒ de tóufa, suǒyǐ wǒ kànqǐlai jiù xiàng gè lǎnhàn.
懒得.e: I'm lazy about my hair, so I tend to look like a slob.

谎言.p: Nǐ de huǎngyán xiàng bàozhǐ yíyàng!
谎言.e: Your lies are just like newspapers!

意图.s: 我把我的意图告诉了我父母。
意图.p: Wǒ bǎ wǒ de yìtú gàosù le wǒ fùmǔ.
意图.e: I made known my intentions to my parents.

译.e: She has a strong wish to work as an interpreter.

着眼.s: 带着眼镜的那位老先生是一位中国小说家。
着眼.p: Dài zhuóyǎn jìng de nà wèi lǎo xiānsheng shì yí wèi Zhōngguó xiǎoshuōjiā.
着眼.e: The man wearing glasses is an old Chinese author.

政党.s: 这个组织跟任何政党没有联系。
政党.p: Zhège zǔzhī gēn rènhé zhèngdǎng méiyǒu liánxì.
政党.e: The organization is not connected with any political parties.

卓越.s: 这表明了地方领导恢复地区卓越水平的雄心。
卓越.p: Zhè biǎomíng le dìfāng lǐngdǎo huīfù dìqū zhuóyuè shuǐpíng de xióngxīn.
卓越.e: It reveals local executives' ambitions of bringing the region back to the top.

倒数.p: Tā shì dàoshǔ dì sān gè dào de.
倒数.e: He was the last but two to arrive.

呕吐.s: 我只能描述这可怕的味道像呕吐物混合着烂肉。
呕吐.p: Wǒ zhǐnéng miáoshù zhè kěpà de wèidao xiàng ǒutùwù hùnhé zhe làn ròu.
呕吐.e: I can only describe the terrible smell as vomit mixed with rotting flesh.

验.s: 我们想验一下您的尿液。
验.p: Wǒmen xiǎng yàn yíxià nín de niàoyè.
验.e: We want to analyze your urine.

致命.s: 这对他来说是致命的打击。
致命.p: Zhè duì tā lái shuō shì zhìmìng de dǎjī.
致命.e: To him this is a deadly blow.

出路.e: It was the only way to go.

脑海.s: 画这幅画的时候你脑海中浮现出了什么图像？
脑海.p: Huà zhè fú huà de shíhou nǐ nǎohǎi zhōng fúxiàn chū le shénme túxiàng?
脑海.e: What image did you have in mind as you painted this picture?

绑.s: 他先清洗了伤口，再绑上绷带。
绑.p: Tā xiān qīngxǐ le shāngkǒu, zài bǎng shàng bēngdài.
绑.e: He cleansed the wound before putting on a bandage.

不解.s: 这个无神论者困惑不解。

一早.s: 我们同意了第二天一早开始。
一早.p: Wǒmen tóngyì le dìèrtiān yìzǎo kāishǐ.
一早.e: We agreed to start early the next morning.

发热.e: I had a little fever this morning.

音响.p: Wǒ mǎi le yítào xīn de yīnxiǎng.
音响.e: I bought a set of brand new speakers.

上行.s: 你可以想象在月球上行走吗？
上行.p: Nǐ kěyǐ xiǎngxiàng zài yuèqiú shàngxíng zǒu ma?
上行.e: Can you imagine walking around on the moon?

样本.e: The sample is not pure enough.

加紧.s: 我们真的得加紧步伐了。
加紧.p: Wǒmen zhēnde de jiājǐn bùfá le.
加紧.e: We've really got to step on it.

磅.p: Tā zhòng èr bǎi qīshí bàng.

核武器.s: 核电厂具危险性，更不用说核武器了。
核武器.p: Hédiànchǎng jù wēixiǎn xìng, gēng búyòngshuō héwǔqì le.
核武器.e: Nuclear power plants are dangerous, not to mention nuclear weapons.

人身.s: 他们中的一些人身体健康，但是其他人不是。
人身.p: Tāmen zhòngdì yìxiē rénshēn tǐ jiànkāng, dànshì qítā rén búshì.
人身.e: Some of them are healthy, but others are not.

资质.s: 我认为，你已经完全具备了潜伏的资质。
资质.p: Wǒ rènwéi, nǐ yǐjīng wánquán jùbèi le qiánfú de zīzhì.
资质.e: I believe you already possess all the qualities needed to go undercover.

手脚.s: 他撞车是因为有人在刹车上做了手脚。
手脚.p: Tā zhuàngchē shì yīnwèi yǒurén zài shāchē shàng zuò le shǒujiǎo.
手脚.e: He crashed his car because someone tampered with the brakes.

代理人.s: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。
代理人.p: Wànyì yǒu jǐnjí qíngkuàng, liánxì wǒ de dàilǐrén.
代理人.e: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.

来电.s: 当你有需要或只是想说话时，请来电！
来电.p: Dāng nǐ yǒu xūyào huò zhǐshì xiǎng shuōhuà shí, qǐng láidiàn!
来电.e: If you need something or want to talk, feel free to call.

揭示.p: Tā jiēshì le yáoyán de zhēnxiàng.
揭示.e: It proved the truth of the rumor.

缘分.e: Let's see what fate has prescribed.

哄.s: 汤姆哄玛丽做他的作业。
哄.p: Tāngmǔ hōng Mǎlì zuò tā de zuòyè.
哄.e: Tom tricked Mary into doing his work for him.

伤感.s: 与朋友吵架是件很伤感情的事。
伤感.p: Yǔ péngyou chǎojià shì jiàn hěn shānggǎn qíng de shì.
伤感.e: Fighting with your friends can really hurt your feelings.

拧.s: 汤姆拧干毛巾挂起来晾干。
拧.p: Tāngmǔ nǐng gàn máojīn guàqǐ lái liànggān.
拧.e: Tom wrung out the towel and hung it up to dry.

直线.p: Zài zhèlǐ huà yì tiáo zhíxiàn.

面孔.s: 你精疲力竭的面孔有时会出现在我眼前。
面孔.p: Nǐ jīngpílìjié de miànkǒng yǒushí huì chūxiàn zài wǒ yǎnqián.
面孔.e: Sometimes that tired-out face of yours appears in front of my eyes.

跨国.s: 跨国公司预料到了规模经济的实行。
跨国.p: Kuàguógōngsī yùliào dàoliǎo guīmójīngjì de shíxíng.
跨国.e: The multinational corporation has forecast the implementation of economies of scale.

窜.s: 小偷迅速地窜入了人群。
窜.p: Xiǎotōu xùnsù de cuàn rù le rénqún.
窜.e: The thief whipped out into the crowd.

上空.s: 月亮和星星在上空照耀着。
上空.p: Yuèliang hé xīngxing zài shàngkōng zhàoyào zhe.
上空.e: The moon and stars were shining above us.

颤抖.s: 她的声音因愤怒而颤抖。
颤抖.p: Tā de shēngyīn yīn fènnù ér chàndǒu.
颤抖.e: Her voice was quivering with anger.

柜台.e: Sami walked up to the counter.

交付.s: 我怎么能忘记您交付我的任务？
交付.p: Wǒ zěnme néng wàngjì nín jiāofù wǒ de rènwu?
交付.e: How could I possibly forget about the task that you've entrusted to me?

海报.s: 那些海报现在都到哪里去了？
海报.p: Nàxiē hǎibào xiànzài dōu dào nǎlǐ qù le?

双向.s: 我可以做中英双向翻译，参加跟外国人交际谈判。
双向.p: Wǒ kěyǐ zuò ZhōngYīng shuāngxiàng fānyì, cānjiā gēn wàiguórén jiāojì tánpàn.
双向.e: I can translate between Chinese and English, and can participate in negotiations with foreigners.

膨胀.e: Interest rates and inflation were high.

体能.s: 迈克尔需要在夏天恢复体能。
体能.p: Màikèěr xūyào zài xiàtiān huīfù tǐnéng.
体能.e: Michael needs to get fit over the summer.

背叛.s: 他为了钱背叛了他的朋友们。
背叛.p: Tā wèile qián bèipàn le tā de péngyou men.
背叛.e: He betrayed his friends for money.

指令.s: 足球教练站在边线上对自己的队伍喊出指令。
指令.p: Zúqiú jiàoliàn zhàn zài biānxiàn shàng duì zìjǐ de duìwǔ hǎn chū zhǐlìng.
指令.e: The manager and coach stood on the touchline shouting out instructions to their team.

保密.p: Wǒ xīwàng nǐ duì cǐ bǎomì.
保密.e: I'd like you to keep this a secret.

困惑.p: Tā hěn kùnhuò gāi zǒu nǎ tiáo lù.
困惑.e: He was doubtful about which way to take.

酝酿.s: 他们的友情酝酿成了爱情。
酝酿.p: Tāmen de yǒuqíng yùnniàng chéngle àiqíng.
酝酿.e: Their friendship ripened into a deep love.

不予.s: 他们说人类要重建巴别塔，我对此不予评价。
不予.p: Tāmen shuō rénlèi yào chóngjiàn Bābiétǎ, wǒ duì cǐ bùyǔ píngjià.
不予.e: They said humanity needs to rebuild the Tower of Babel, I have no comment on this.

封面.s: 不要根据封面来判断一本书。
封面.p: Búyào gēnjù fēngmiàn lái pànduàn yì běn shū.
封面.e: Don't judge a book by its cover.

伤势.s: 她的父母不能不担心她的伤势。
伤势.p: Tā de fùmǔ bùnéngbù dānxīn tā de shāngshì.
伤势.e: Her parents can't help worrying about her injuries.

弓.p: Māo gōng qǐ bèi, shēn le gè lǎnyāo.
弓.e: The cat arched its back and stretched itself.

撤离.s: 士兵们撤离了他们的阵地。
撤离.p: Shìbīng men chèlí le tāmen de zhèndì.
撤离.e: The soldiers retreated from their positions.

自私.s: 她确实很漂亮，但她很自私。
自私.p: Tā quèshí hěn piàoliang, dàn tā hěn zìsī.
自私.e: It is true that she is pretty, but she is selfish.

卡车.p: Duōme dà de yí liàng kǎchē a!

照射.s: 虽然有阳光照射，但还是很冷。
照射.p: Suīrán yǒu yángguāng zhàoshè, dàn háishi hěn lěng.
照射.e: The sun was shining, yet it was cold.

盏.s: 他把一盏灯挂在了天花板上。
盏.p: Tā bǎ yì zhǎn dēng guà zài le tiānhuābǎn shàng.
盏.e: He hung a lamp from the ceiling.

入侵.s: 他们抵御入侵者，保卫了国家。
入侵.p: Tāmen dǐyù rùqīnzhě, bǎowèi le guójiā.
入侵.e: They defended their country against the invaders.

漆.p: Wǒmen bǎ wūzi qī chéng lǜsè.

指望.s: 别指望别人来为你考虑！
指望.p: Bié zhǐwàng biéren lái wèi nǐ kǎolǜ!
指望.e: Don't expect others to think for you!

无辜.p: Tāmen dōu shì wúgū de háizi.

拽.s: 她把他从烂泥中拽出来了。
拽.p: Tā bǎ tā cóng lànní zhōng zhuài chūlái le.
拽.e: She pulled him out of the mud.

稳健.s: 他迈着稳健的步伐登上了山丘。
稳健.p: Tā mài zhe wěnjiàn de bùfá dēngshàng le shānqiū.
稳健.e: He was walking up the hill at a steady pace.

膝盖.s: 玛丽处理了膝盖的伤口。
膝盖.p: Mǎlì chǔlǐ le xīgài de shāngkǒu.

充当.e: I'll act as a guide for you.

指南.e: The compass points to the north.

咽.s: 不喝水我咽不下这些药片。
咽.p: Bù hē shuǐ wǒ yān búxià zhèxiē yàopiàn.
咽.e: I can't swallow these tablets without a drink of water.

安定.s: 他们在乡村安定了下来。
安定.p: Tāmen zài xiāngcūn āndìng le xiàlai.

杀害.s: 来自波士顿的一对夫妇也被杀害了。
杀害.p: Láizì Bōshìdùn de yíduì fūfù yě bèi shāhài le.
杀害.e: A couple from Boston was also killed.

投降.s: 我们要向这个怪兽投降吗？
投降.p: Wǒmen yào xiàng zhège guàishòu tóuxiáng ma?
投降.e: Are we going to surrender to these monsters?

绿地.s: 这片小区的绿地面积有多少？
绿地.p: Zhè piàn xiǎoqū de lǜdì miànjī yǒu duōshǎo?
绿地.e: What is the size of this district's greenery area?

视察.s: 干部们视察了我们的学校。
视察.p: Gànbù men shìchá le wǒmen de xuéxiào.

愈合.s: 汤姆腿上的伤口愈合了。
愈合.p: Tāngmǔ tuǐ shàng de shāngkǒu yùhé le.
愈合.e: The wound on Tom's leg has healed.

体质.s: 她确实年轻貌美，但她体质娇弱。
体质.p: Tā quèshí niánqīng màoměi, dàn tā tǐzhì jiāoruò.
体质.e: Indeed she is young and beautiful, but she is in delicate health.

指甲.p: Tā yǒu yǎo zhǐjia de xíguàn.
指甲.e: She has a habit of biting her nails.

监视.e: He is keeping an eye out.

卡通.s: 书桌上一叠专业书里有几本卡通书混在里面。
卡通.p: Shūzhuō shàng yì dié zhuānyè shū lǐ yǒu jǐ běn kǎtōng shū hùn zài lǐmiàn.
卡通.e: There were some graphic novels mixed into the pile of specialty books on the desk.

副作用.e: This medicine does not have side effects.

揭露.s: 这种秘密总有一天会被揭露的。
揭露.p: Zhèzhǒng mìmì zǒngyǒu yì tiān huì bèi jiēlù de.
揭露.e: Such secrets are always eventually revealed.

持平.s: 在结冰的街道上我们很难保持平衡。
持平.p: Zài jiébīng de jiēdào shàng wǒmen hěn nánbǎo chípíng héng.
持平.e: It is hard to keep our balance on icy streets.

慎重.e: You should choose your friends very carefully.

揉.p: Tā róu le róu tā de yǎnjing.

处方.s: 那个药的话没有处方是买不到的。
处方.p: Nàge yào dehuà méiyǒu chǔfāng shì mǎi búdào de.
处方.e: You can't buy this medicine without a prescription.

摧毁.s: 这座城市在战争中被摧毁。
摧毁.p: Zhè zuò chéngshì zài zhànzhēng zhōng bèi cuīhuǐ.
摧毁.e: The city was destroyed in the war.

掩盖.e: She didn't try to hide the truth.

星球.s: 我们能拯救这颗星球吗？
星球.p: Wǒmen néng zhěngjiù zhè kē xīngqiú ma?

回想.s: 那座城市的景色让我回想起了伦敦。
回想.p: Nà zuò chéngshì de jǐngsè ràng wǒ huíxiǎng qǐ le Lúndūn.
回想.e: The scenery of the city reminded me of London.

雷达.p: Zhè sōu chuán méiyǒu léidá zhuāngbèi.
雷达.e: The ship is not equipped with radar.

妥协.e: I am strongly opposed to a compromise.

海啸.p: Hǎixiào lái le, mìqiè zhùyì a.
海啸.e: A tsunami is coming, so please be on the alert.

坚信.p: Wǒ jiānxìn tā huì bāng wǒ de.
坚信.e: I don't doubt that he will help me.

确切.p: Quèqiè de shuō, xiànzài sān diǎn le.
确切.e: The exact time is three now.

庙.p: Wǒmen yě qù le miào lǐ.
庙.e: We also went to the temple.

根源.s: 我无法找到问题的根源。
根源.p: Wǒ wúfǎ zhǎodào wèntí de gēnyuán.
根源.e: I can't locate the source of the problem.

公关.s: 他们公司的公关团队非常强悍。
公关.p: Tāmen gōngsī de gōngguān tuánduì fēicháng qiánghàn.
公关.e: Their company's public relations team is very strong.

医务.e: You'd better go to the infirmary.

烦躁.s: 等朋友等太久时,会感到烦躁.
烦躁.p: Děng péngyou děng tài jiǔ shí, huì gǎndào fánzào.
烦躁.e: I feel restless when I have to wait too long for my friend to show up.

剥夺.s: 这项法律会剥夺我们的基本权利。
剥夺.p: Zhè xiàng fǎlǜ huì bōduó wǒmen de jīběn quánlì.
剥夺.e: This law will deprive us of our basic rights.

压制.s: 法国是在试图压制阿尔及利亚的发展吗？
压制.p: Fǎguó shì zài shìtú yāzhì Āěrjílìyà de fāzhǎn ma?
压制.e: Is France trying to suppress Algeria's development?

糊.p: Nǐ kěndìng nǎozi hú diào le.

期盼.s: 今祯子当时能做的就是折纸鹤并期盼奇迹。
期盼.p: Jīn zhēn zi dāngshí néng zuò de jiùshì zhézhǐ hè bìng qīpàn qíjì.
期盼.e: All Sadako could do now was to make paper cranes and hope for a miracle.

永久.s: 你还年轻，可是没有永久。
永久.p: Nǐ hái niánqīng, kěshì méiyǒu yǒngjiǔ.
永久.e: You're still young, but not permanently.

下场.s: 球员们跑下场，在中场休息时开了一个会。
下场.p: Qiúyuán men pǎo xiàchǎng, zài zhōngchǎng xiūxi shí kāi le yìge huì.
下场.e: The players ran off the pitch and had a meeting during half-time.

溜.e: He walks his dog every morning.

无穷.e: It is a lot of fun to drive a car.

良心.s: 他对一个生病的男人说这种事真是没良心。
良心.p: Tā duì yìge shēngbìng de nánrén shuō zhèzhǒng shì zhēnshi méi liángxīn.
良心.e: It was heartless of him to say such a thing to the sick man.

无偿.s: 我愿意无偿接下这件活。
无偿.p: Wǒ yuànyì wúcháng jiēxià zhè jiàn huó.
无偿.e: I'd be willing to do that for free.

示威.s: 工会参加了示威游行吗？
示威.e: Did the union participate in the demonstration?

无缘.s: 有缘千里来相会，无缘对面不相逢。
无缘.p: Yǒuyuán qiānlǐ lái xiānghuì, wúyuán duìmiàn bù xiāngféng.
无缘.e: Those fated to meet will do so regardless of distance. Those not fated will not, even if they are across from one another.

流畅.s: 要是我能流畅地读法语就好了。
流畅.p: Yàoshi wǒ néng liúchàng de dúfǎ yǔ jiù hǎo le.
流畅.e: I would love to be able to read French effortlessly.

艰巨.s: 我老板把艰巨的任务指派给了我。
艰巨.p: Wǒ lǎobǎn bǎ jiānjù de rènwu zhǐpài gěi le wǒ.
艰巨.e: My boss assigned the hard job to me.

扒.s: 我的信用卡在地铁上被扒了。
扒.p: Wǒ de xìnyòngkǎ zàidì tiě shàng bèi pá le.
扒.e: My credit card was stolen on the subway.

农场.p: Tā quánjiā dōu zài nóngchǎng gōngzuò.
农场.e: All of his family work on a farm.

改良.s: 经理打算改良公司的结构。
改良.p: Jīnglǐ dǎsuàn gǎiliáng gōngsī de jiégòu.
改良.e: The manager wants to improve the company's structuring.

牢牢.s: 他牢牢地抓住了她的手臂。
牢牢.p: Tā láoláo de zhuāzhù le tā de shǒubì.

揭晓.s: 这则故事最悲情的部分尚未揭晓。
揭晓.p: Zhè zé gùshì zuì bēi qíng de bùfen shàngwèi jiēxiǎo.
揭晓.e: The saddest part of the story remains to be told.

实地.p: Wǒ shì gè jiǎotàshídì de rén.
实地.e: I have my feet firmly planted on the ground.

旋律.s: 我想不起那首歌的旋律。
旋律.p: Wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ nà shǒu gē de xuánlǜ.
旋律.e: I can't remember the melody of that song.

捅.p: Tāngmǔ bèi rén yòng dāo tǒng sǐ le.

瞄准.e: The policeman aimed his gun at the man.

谜.s: 要解开谋杀背后潜藏之谜！
谜.p: Yào jiěkāi móushā bèihòu qiáncáng zhī mí!
谜.e: Solve the mystery lurking behind the murder!

界限.s: 所有的事物都要被怀疑、被验证，思想没有界限。
界限.p: Suǒyǒu de shìwù dōu yào bèi huáiyí, bèi yànzhèng, sīxiǎng méiyǒu jièxiàn.
界限.e: Everything has been suspected and been inspected; thoughts have no boundaries.

辩护.p: Wǒ zài gěi móguǐ dāng biànhùshì.
辩护.e: I'm just playing the devil's advocate.

查明.s: 我们必须查明汤姆在哪里。
查明.p: Wǒmen bìxū chámíng Tāngmǔ zài nǎlǐ.
查明.e: We have to find out where Tom is.

亲手.p: Tā wèi wǒ qīnshǒu suǒ shā.
亲手.e: He was killed by my hand.

就诊.s: 医生现在正在给那位患者就诊。
就诊.p: Yīshēng xiànzài zhèngzài gěi nà wèi huànzhě jiùzhěn.
就诊.e: The doctor is seeing that patient.

陷阱.s: 他们利用陷阱捕捉狐狸。
陷阱.e: Using a trap, they caught the fox.

拌.s: 我把蛋黄酱和番茄酱拌到一起。
拌.p: Wǒ bǎ dànhuángjiàng hé fānqiéjiàng bàn dào yìqǐ.

偿还.s: 这个家庭非常贫穷以至于无法偿还贷款。
偿还.p: Zhège jiātíng fēicháng pínqióng yǐzhìyú wúfǎ chánghuán dàikuǎn.
偿还.e: The family is too poor to pay back the debts.

弦.s: 我弄断了我吉他的一根弦。
弦.p: Wǒ nòng duàn le wǒ jítā de yì gēn xián.
弦.e: I broke a string on my guitar.

奔波.s: 在一整天工作的奔波中，她的腿变得酸痛。
奔波.p: Zài yì zhěngtiān gōngzuò de bēnbō zhōng, tā de tuǐ biànde suāntòng.
奔波.e: Her feet were tired after a long day at work.

不由得.e: I can never forget my hometown.

搭档.s: 羊屁股先生可没告诉我还有搭档。
搭档.p: Yáng pìgu xiānsheng kě méi gàosù wǒ háiyǒu dādàng.
搭档.e: Mr. Goat Butt never told me there would be a partner.

弥漫.s: 玫瑰的芬芳弥漫了整个房间.
弥漫.p: Méiguī de fēnfāng mímàn le zhěnggè fángjiān.
弥漫.e: The smell of roses filled the room.

天鹅.p: Zhè zhǐ tiāné shì hēisè de.

庆幸.s: 值得庆幸的是他双亲性情非常温和。
庆幸.p: Zhíde qìngxìng de shì tā shuāngqīn xìngqíng fēicháng wēnhé.
庆幸.e: It's lucky that his parents are so equable.

人质.p: Zuìfàn méiyǒu fàng rénzhì men zǒu.
人质.e: The criminal didn't let the hostages go.

招牌.s: 让我们点龙虾！听说是这里的招牌菜。
招牌.p: Ràng wǒmen diǎn lóngxiā! Tīngshuō shì zhèlǐ de zhāopáicài.
招牌.e: Let’s order the lobster! I’ve heard that’s the specialty dish here.

编剧.s: 这几年美剧的编剧几乎都是同性恋。
编剧.p: Zhè jǐnián Měijù de biānjù jīhū dōu shì tóngxìngliàn.
编剧.e: Almost all the American TV series of the last few years were written by homosexuals.

沙滩.p: Tā yào gēn tā yìqǐ qù shātān.
沙滩.e: He wanted to go to the beach with her.

额外.e: You need to pay extra for the batteries.

不服.e: He refuses to accept his old age.

容忍.p: Nà nǚshì róngrěn le nà nánrén.

傻瓜.s: 你认为我把自己当傻瓜？
傻瓜.p: Nǐ rènwéi wǒ bǎ zìjǐ dāng shǎguā?
傻瓜.e: Do you think I think of myself as an idiot?

注视.s: 她注视着一个不明飞行物，哑口无言。
注视.p: Tā zhùshì zhe yìge bùmíngfēixíngwù, yǎkǒuwúyán.
注视.e: She stared at a UFO in silence.

官司.s: 我最后还是输了那场官司。
官司.p: Wǒ zuìhòu háishi shū le nà chǎng guānsi.
官司.e: I have lost the case after all.

心酸.s: 自从得到他爸爸去了以来，戴夫就心酸。
心酸.p: Zìcóng dédào tā bàba qù le yǐlái, dài fū jiù xīnsuān.
心酸.e: Ever since his father died, David has been very sad.

悬挂.p: Tā de huà bèi xuánguà zài qiáng shàng.
悬挂.e: His pictures were hung on the wall.

守护.s: 默默守护中，有人跑到街头，叫来了协警。
守护.p: Mòmò shǒuhù zhōng, yǒurén pǎo dào jiētóu, jiào lái le xiéjǐng.
守护.e: As everyone stood guard silently, someone ran to the corner of the street and called over a police officer.

赞扬.s: 赞扬比批评更容易让人接受。
赞扬.p: Zànyáng bǐ pīpíng gēng róngyì ràng rén jiēshòu.
赞扬.e: People can accept praise more easily than criticism.

罢工.e: They already called off the strike.

纯洁.p: Tā yǒu yì kē chúnjié de xīn.

怪不得.s: 这家商店人员的态度特好，怪不得顾客也好多。
怪不得.p: Zhè jiā shāngdiàn rényuán de tàidu tè hǎo, guàibùde gùkè yěhǎo duō.
怪不得.e: The staff in this shop are really friendly. It's no wonder they've got so much custom.

无须.s: 汤姆无须钱财也能享受。
无须.p: Tāngmǔ wúxū qiáncái yě néng xiǎngshòu.
无须.e: Tom doesn't need money to have a good time.

吉他.s: 他在哪里买的这个吉他？
吉他.p: Tā zài nǎlǐ mǎi de zhège jítā?
吉他.e: Where did he buy this guitar?

忠实.p: Wǒ shì zúqiú de zhōngshí fěnsī.

缘故.s: 你知道为什么吗？是猫的缘故。
缘故.p: Nǐ zhīdào wèishénme ma? Shì māo de yuángù.
缘故.e: And you know why? Because of cats.

礼仪.e: She has no manners at all.

惯.p: Wǒ zǒu bú guàn yuǎn lù.
惯.e: I am not accustomed to walking long distances.

起伏.e: In life there are ups and downs.

指向.s: 我把我的手枪指向了目标。
指向.p: Wǒ bǎ wǒ de shǒuqiāng zhǐxiàng le mùbiāo.
指向.e: I aimed my gun at the target.

气愤.s: 我对这种愚蠢的行为表示非常的气愤。
气愤.p: Wǒ duì zhèzhǒng yúchǔn de xíngwéi biǎoshì fēicháng de qìfèn.
气愤.e: I'm getting endlessly annoyed by this foolishness.

法则.s: 就连我们的头脑也遵守物理法则。
法则.p: Jiù lián wǒmen de tóunǎo yě zūnshǒu wùlǐ fǎzé.
法则.e: Even our brains are subject to the laws of physics.

寻常.p: Tāngmǔ shì gè bù xúncháng de rén.

凶手.s: 园丁后来发现就是凶手。
凶手.e: The gardener turned out to be the murderer.

性命.s: 事故差点让他丢了性命。
性命.p: Shìgù chàdiǎn ràng tā diū le xìngmìng.
性命.e: The accident almost cost him his life.

集会.s: 有成千的人来参加今天的集会。
集会.p: Yǒuchéng qiān de rén lái cānjiā jīntiān de jíhuì.
集会.e: There are thousands of participants at today's event.

发泄.s: 发泄很少改善我的情绪，反而经常使它更糟。
发泄.p: Fāxiè hěn shǎo gǎishàn wǒ de qíngxù, fǎnér jīngcháng shǐ tā gēng zāo.
发泄.e: Venting rarely improves my mood and often makes it worse.

后勤.s: 外行谈策略，内行谈后勤。
后勤.p: Wàiháng tán cèlüè, nèiháng tán hòuqín.
后勤.e: Amateurs talk strategy, professionals talk logistics.

撞击.s: 进一步的检查发现头骨受到剧烈的撞击而碎裂。
撞击.p: Jìnyíbù de jiǎnchá fāxiàn tóugǔ shòudào jùliè de zhuàngjī ér suìliè.
撞击.e: Another step forward revealed that the skull had received violent impact and disintegrated.

分割.s: 爱尔兰和英格兰被海分割。
分割.p: Àiěrlán hé Yīnggélán bèi hǎi fēngē.
分割.e: A sea separates Ireland and England.

伪装.p: Yǐjīng bù xūyào zài wěizhuāng le.
伪装.e: There's no need to pretend anymore.

担当.s: 他要负责任，但这责任他可担当不了。
担当.p: Tā yào fùzérèn, dàn zhè zérèn tā kě dāndāng bùle.
担当.e: He had to be responsible, but this was a responsibility that he couldn’t bear.

以至于.s: 她太过好奇，以至于打开了盒子。
以至于.p: Tā tàiguò hàoqí, yǐzhìyú dǎkāi le hézi.
以至于.e: She was so curious that she opened the box.

同等.e: These products are of the same quality.

魔鬼.p: Móguǐ bī wǒ zhème zuò de.
魔鬼.e: The Devil made me do it.

隐瞒.s: 不要隐瞒你对此的想法。
隐瞒.p: Búyào yǐnmán nǐ duì cǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
隐瞒.e: Don't conceal what you feel about it.

吩咐.s: 接下来该怎么做，我完全听从您的吩咐。
吩咐.p: Jiēxiàlái gāi zěnme zuò, wǒ wánquán tīngcóng nín de fēnfu.
吩咐.e: I will follow your advice fully from here onwards.

尽头.s: 直走直到这条街道的尽头。
尽头.p: Zhí zǒu zhídào zhè tiáo jiēdào de jìntóu.
尽头.e: Go straight on to the end of the road.

光盘.s: 我有不低于一千片光盘。
光盘.p: Wǒ yǒu bù dīyú yì qiān piàn guāngpán.
光盘.e: I have no less than one thousand records.

太平.s: 太平洋是世界上最大的海洋。
太平.p: TàipíngYáng shì shìjiè shàng zuì dà de hǎiyáng.
太平.e: The Pacific is the largest ocean in the world.

归属.s: 他不知道这些东西的归属。
归属.p: Tā bùzhī dào zhèxiē dōngxī de guīshǔ.
归属.e: He's unaware of who possesses them.

判定.s: 裁判吹响了口哨，判定他手球。
判定.p: Cáipàn chuī xiǎng le kǒushào, pàndìng tā shǒuqiú.
判定.e: The referee blew the whistle and called a hand ball on him.

英勇.s: 他英勇的行为带给了他光荣。
英勇.p: Tā yīngyǒng de xíngwéi dàigěi le tā guāngróng.
英勇.e: His acts of courage brought him glory.

堵塞.s: 市中心的交通都堵塞了。
堵塞.p: Shìzhōngxīn de jiāotōng dōu dǔsè le.
堵塞.e: Traffic downtown is all backed up.

闸.s: 愚蠢骑着没有闸的单车。
闸.p: Yúchǔn qí zhe méiyǒu zhá de dānchē.
闸.e: Stupidity is riding a bike that doesn't have brakes.

要好.s: 她今天比昨天要好很多。
要好.p: Tā jīntiān bǐ zuótiān yàohǎo hěn duō.
要好.e: She is far better today than yesterday.

芝麻.p: Wǒ chī le hēi zhīma bīngqílín.
芝麻.e: I ate black sesame ice cream.

光滑.s: 在光滑的路上开车会导致车祸。
光滑.p: Zài guānghuá de lùshang kāichē huì dǎozhì chēhuò.
光滑.e: Driving on a slippery road can lead to a car wreck.

幕后.s: 你确定汤姆是幕后主使吗？
幕后.p: Nǐ quèdìng Tāngmǔ shì mùhòu zhǔshǐ ma?
幕后.e: Are you sure that Tom is behind this?

争执.s: 我和洋子有了一点争执。
争执.p: Wǒ hé yáng zi yǒule yìdiǎn zhēngzhí.
争执.e: I argued with Yoko a little bit.

渔民.s: 渔民用他的网捕到了一只紫色的水母。
渔民.p: Yúmín yòng tā de wǎng bǔ dàoliǎo yì zhǐ zǐsè de shuǐmǔ.
渔民.e: The fisherman caught a purple jellyfish in his net.

终结.s: 所有悲剧都由死亡终结。
终结.p: Suǒyǒu bēijù dōu yóu sǐwáng zhōngjié.
终结.e: All tragedies end with a death.

无非.s: 他无非是别人的跟屁虫。
无非.p: Tā wúfēi shì biéren de gēnpìchóng.

骚扰.s: 让你的儿子别来骚扰我的女儿。
骚扰.p: Ràng nǐ de érzi bié lái sāorǎo wǒ de nǚér.
骚扰.e: Tell your son to quit harassing my daughter.

削.p: Wǒ zài xuē qíncài hé tǔdòu.
削.e: I am peeling the celery and the potatoes.

手枪.s: 我把我的手枪指向了目标。
手枪.p: Wǒ bǎ wǒ de shǒuqiāng zhǐxiàng le mùbiāo.
手枪.e: I aimed my gun at the target.

遗留.s: 我一定是把它遗留在巴士上了。
遗留.p: Wǒ yídìng shì bǎ tā yíliú zài bāshì shàng le.
遗留.e: I must have left it on the bus.

剥.e: I'll peel an orange for you.

牢固.s: 绳子不够牢固，撑不住他。
牢固.p: Shéngzi búgòu láogù, chēng búzhù tā.
牢固.e: The rope wasn't strong enough to support him.

拘留.e: The police held him in custody.

地毯.s: 窗帘和地毯都重新换过了。
地毯.p: Chuānglián hé dìtǎn dōu chóngxīn huàn guò le.

煤气.p: Wǒ gāi zài nǎr fù méiqì fèi?
煤气.e: Where do I pay for the gas?

名誉.s: 尽管有金钱和名誉，他还是不幸福。
名誉.p: Jǐnguǎn yǒu jīnqián hé míngyù, tā háishi búxìng fú.
名誉.e: Even with all his wealth and fame, he's unhappy.

闪烁.e: Countless stars were twinkling in the sky.

无知.p: Tā chángcháng lìyòng tā de wúzhī.
无知.e: She often takes advantage of his ignorance.

削减.s: 公司为了削减成本，拒绝让员工自行加班。
削减.p: Gōngsī wèile xuējiǎn chéngběn, jùjué ràng yuángōng zìxíng jiābān.
削减.e: In order to cut down on costs, the company refuses to allow employees to work overtime.

掐.s: 放开我，你正在掐着我的脖子。
掐.p: Fàngkāi wǒ, nǐ zhèngzài qiā zhe wǒ de bózi.
掐.e: Let me go, you're choking me.

胶囊.s: 那个建筑物是男女都可以住宿的胶囊酒店。
胶囊.p: Nàge jiànzhùwù shì nánnǚ dōu kěyǐ zhùsù de jiāonángjiǔdiàn.
胶囊.e: This building is a capsule hotel lodging men and women.

心事.s: 你是不是有什么心事？来，跟我说说吧。
心事.p: Nǐ shìbúshì yǒu shénme xīnshì? Lái, gēn wǒ shuōshuo ba.
心事.e: Is there something you want to get off your chest? Come on, you can tell me.

平日.s: 你今儿跟平日里不太一样。
平日.p: Nǐ jīnr gēn píngrì lǐ bú tài yíyàng.
平日.e: There's something off about you today.

尽早.e: Let me know the result as soon as you can.

目睹.s: 所目睹的不一定是真的。
目睹.p: Suǒ mùdǔ de bùyídìng shì zhēnde.
目睹.e: Things that you see with your eyes are not necessarily true.

脱落.p: Qiáng shàng de zhǐ jiànjiàn tuōluò le.
脱落.e: The paper was beginning to peel off the walls.

急于.p: Tā jíyú jiàn tā de fùqīn.
急于.e: She was in a hurry to see her father.

历来.s: 这是我们历来经历过最大的地震。
历来.p: Zhè shì wǒmen lìlái jīnglì guò zuì dà de dìzhèn.
历来.e: The earthquake was the biggest one that we had ever experienced.

冷却.s: 金属冷却的时候会收缩。
冷却.p: Jīnshǔ lěngquè de shíhou huì shōusuō.

手掌.s: 我不用曲膝就能把我的手掌放到地上。
手掌.p: Wǒ búyòng qū xī jiù néng bǎ wǒ de shǒuzhǎng fàng dào dìshang.
手掌.e: I can place the palms of my hands on the floor without bending my knees.

莫非.s: 溥天之下，莫非王土；率土之滨，莫非王臣。
莫非.p: Pǔ tiān zhīxià, mòfēi wáng tǔ; lǜ tǔ zhī bīn, mòfēi wáng chén.
莫非.e: Under the vast heaven, no land is not the king's land; at the edges of the land, no one is not the king's subject.

按钮.s: 发生意外的话按这个红按钮。
按钮.p: Fāshēng yìwài dehuà àn zhège hóng ànniǔ.
按钮.e: Push the red button if something strange happens.

间谍.s: 他相信我们中间有间谍。
间谍.p: Tā xiāngxìn wǒmen zhōngjiān yǒu jiàndié.
间谍.e: He believes there is a spy among us.

平和.s: 我所想要的是一点平和和安静。
平和.p: Wǒ suǒ xiǎngyào de shì yìdiǎn pínghé hé ānjìng.
平和.e: What I want is some peace and quiet.

救济.s: 十年来，他靠父亲的救济生存。
救济.p: Shí niánlái, tā kào fùqīn de jiùjì shēngcún.
救济.e: He's been living off his father's financial support for ten years now.

当真.p: Tā bǎ wǒ de wánxiào dàngzhēn le.

无耻.p: Nǐ rènwéi Tāngmǔ hěn wúchǐ ma?
无耻.e: Do you think Tom is unscrupulous?

赞美.s: 他把她的话当作是一种赞美。
赞美.p: Tā bǎ tā dehuà dàngzuò shì yìzhǒng zànměi.
赞美.e: He took her words as a compliment.

天赋.s: 我发现了他在化学方面的天赋。
天赋.p: Wǒ fāxiàn le tā zài huàxué fāngmiàn de tiānfù.
天赋.e: I found him a genius at chemistry.

引人注目.s: 她说理的主线引人注目，但从根本上是靠不住的。
引人注目.p: Tā shuōlǐ de zhǔxiàn yǐnrénzhùmù, dàn cóng gēnběn shàng shì kàobúzhù de.
引人注目.e: Her line of reasoning is attractive, but ultimately fallacious.

铲.s: 汤姆正要为我们铲掉屋顶上的雪。
铲.p: Tāngmǔ zhèngyào wèi wǒmen chǎn diào wūdǐng shàng de xuě.
铲.e: Tom is going to shovel the snow off the roof for us.

意味.s: 我认为我知道那意味着什么。
意味.p: Wǒ rènwéi wǒ zhīdào nà yìwèizhe shénme.
意味.e: I think that I know what this means.

照样.s: 就算这样地球也照样转！
照样.p: Jiùsuàn zhèyàng dìqiú yě zhàoyàng zhuǎn!

非凡.e: He is remarkable for his wisdom.

社交.s: 你不应该在社交网络上分享过多私人信息。
社交.p: Nǐ bù yīnggāi zài shèjiāo wǎngluò shàngfēn xiǎng guòduō sīrén xìnxī.
社交.e: You shouldn't share too much private information on the social networks.

毁灭.s: 没有你的话，我的生命就毁灭了。
毁灭.p: Méiyǒu nǐ dehuà, wǒ de shēngmìng jiù huǐmiè le.

老乡.p: Yuánlái nǐ hé wǒ shì lǎoxiāng.
老乡.e: It turns out that you and I come from the same country.

手册.s: 这本书对新手来说是一本很好的手册。
手册.p: Zhè běn shū duì xīnshǒu lái shuō shì yì běn hěn hǎo de shǒucè.
手册.e: This book is a good guide for beginners.

来访.p: Nà nánháir láifǎng guò wǒ jiā.
来访.e: That boy used to drop in on me.

炫耀.e: Stop being so arrogant about this.

引用.s: 你中文真好，都能引用俗语了。
引用.p: Nǐ Zhōngwén zhēn hǎo, dōu néng yǐnyòng súyǔ le.
引用.e: Your Chinese is so good, you can quote proverbs.

处境.p: Wǒ wánquán lǐjiě nǐ de chǔjìng.
处境.e: I can understand your position perfectly.

解剖.s: 丹甚至没有上过基础解剖课。
解剖.p: Dān shènzhì méiyǒu shàng guò jīchǔ jiěpōu kè.
解剖.e: Dan didn't even take basic anatomy classes.

泻.s: 有一个人住在福冈，其他人住在新泻。
泻.p: Yǒu yígèrén zhù zài Fúgāng, qítā rén zhù zài xīn xiè.
泻.e: One lives in Fukuoka, and the others live in Niigata.

遗漏.s: 用法语，很少会遗漏主语。
遗漏.p: Yòngfǎ yǔ, hěn shǎo huì yílòu zhǔyǔ.
遗漏.e: In French, you can rarely omit the subject.

通货膨胀.s: 随着通货膨胀的发展美元贬值了。
通货膨胀.p: Suízhe tōnghuòpéngzhàng de fāzhǎn měiyuán biǎnzhí le.
通货膨胀.e: The value of the dollar declines as the rate of inflation rises.

昏迷.s: 患者现在处于深度昏迷状态。
昏迷.p: Huànzhě xiànzài chǔyú shēndù hūnmí zhuàngtài.
昏迷.e: The patient is in a deep coma.

触摸.e: Can I touch this one too?

蠢.p: Wǒ gāng shuō le hěn chǔn dehuà.
蠢.e: I just said something very stupid.

罪犯.p: Zuìfàn méiyǒu fàng rénzhì men zǒu.
罪犯.e: The criminal didn't let the hostages go.

圈子.s: 在福瑞圈子里，不少人都会进行一些创作。
圈子.p: Zài fúruì quānzi lǐ, bùshǎo rén dūhuì jìnxíng yìxiē chuàngzuò.
圈子.e: In the furry fandom, many are artists of some sort.

吓人.s: 我总觉得木偶戏有点吓人。
吓人.p: Wǒ zǒng juéde mùǒuxì yǒudiǎn xiàrén.
吓人.e: I always find puppet shows a bit creepy.

疯子.p: Tā biǎoxiàn de xiàng gè fēngzi.

迟早.e: Sooner or later, you will regret your idleness.

贫穷.e: Poor as he is, he is happy.

捕捉.s: 他们利用陷阱捕捉狐狸。
捕捉.e: Using a trap, they caught the fox.

懂事.s: 我觉得你是时候该懂事了。
懂事.p: Wǒ juéde nǐ shì shíhou gāi dǒngshì le.
懂事.e: I think it's time for you to grow up.

顾虑.e: I don't have a care in the world.

时而.e: I am by turns an optimist and a pessimist.

出卖.e: He sold me down the river.

蚊子.p: Wǒ gānggang bèi wénzi yǎo le.
蚊子.e: I just got bitten by a mosquito.

遗失.s: 汤姆找到了他以为已经遗失的钥匙。
遗失.p: Tāngmǔ zhǎodào le tā yǐwéi yǐjīng yíshī de yàoshi.
遗失.e: Tom found the key that he thought he'd lost.

亲眼.p: Wǒ mèimei qīnyǎn kàndào tā le.
亲眼.e: My sister saw it with her own eyes.

窒息.e: The whole thing is utterly oppressive.

虚伪.p: Wǒ bù xǐhuan xūwěi de xìntú.

渔船.s: 迷路的渔船安全地返回了港口。
渔船.p: Mílù de yúchuán ānquán dìfǎn huí le gǎngkǒu.
渔船.e: The lost fishing boat made a safe return to harbour.

君子.p: Tā yǐ jūnzǐ zhī dào shēnghuó.

万能.s: 我知道金钱不是万能的。
万能.p: Wǒ zhīdào jīnqián búshì wànnéng de.
万能.e: I know that money isn't everything.

辩论.p: Zhè shì chǎng yǒuqù de biànlùn.

重任.e: A great responsibility lies on his shoulders.

眯.s: 我眯了一会之后把作业写了。
眯.p: Wǒ mī le yíhuì zhīhòu bǎ zuòyè xiě le.
眯.e: I did my homework after I took a nap.

海滨.s: 他是一家海滨餐厅的服务员。
海滨.p: Tā shì yìjiā hǎibīn cāntīng de fúwùyuán.
海滨.e: He is a waiter in a seaside restaurant.

激起.p: Wǒ de xìngqù bèi jīqǐ lái le.

丑闻.s: 这是一件全国性的丑闻。
丑闻.p: Zhè shì yí jiàn quánguóxìng de chǒuwén.

瘫痪.s: 他的瘫痪正在恶化，不久他就不能下床了。
瘫痪.p: Tā de tānhuàn zhèngzài èhuà, bùjiǔ tā jiù bùnéng xià chuáng le.
瘫痪.e: His paralysis is progressing, and soon he won't be able to get out of bed.

流血.s: 今天早上我耳朵流血了。
流血.p: Jīntiān zǎoshang wǒ ěrduo liúxuè le.
流血.e: My ear was bleeding this morning.

不定.s: 谁能赢这场比赛还说不定。
不定.p: Shéi néng yíng zhè chǎng bǐsài hái shuōbúdìng.
不定.e: It's still not certain who's going to win this match.

上司.p: Wǒ de shàngsi bèi bīpò cízhí.
上司.e: My boss was forced to resign.

愉悦.s: 学习新的知识令人愉悦。
愉悦.p: Xuéxí xīn de zhīshi lìngrén yúyuè.
愉悦.e: Learning new information can make people happy.

愚蠢.s: 你相信他真是太愚蠢了。
愚蠢.p: Nǐ xiāngxìn tā zhēnshi tài yúchǔn le.
愚蠢.e: It is stupid of you to believe in him.

粗糙.s: 她的裙子是用粗糙的羊毛造的。
粗糙.p: Tā de qúnzi shì yòng cūcāo de yángmáo zào de.
粗糙.e: Her dress was made of coarse wool.

极力.e: He praised me to the skies.

泄漏.s: 这秘密是怎么泄漏出去的？
泄漏.p: Zhè mìmì shì zěnme xièlòu chūqù de?
泄漏.e: How did the secret get out?

推翻.e: Reactionary groups were overthrown by the people.

垮.s: 他干活太用功，把身体弄垮了。
垮.p: Tā gànhuó tài yònggōng, bǎ shēntǐ nòng kuǎ le.
垮.e: He worked too hard and destroyed his health.

明朗.s: 当我离开家的时候天空很明朗。
明朗.p: Dāng wǒ líkāi jiāde shíhou tiānkōng hěn mínglǎng.
明朗.e: The sky was clear when I left home.

忍耐.e: Patience is the most beautiful virtue.

无意.p: Wǒ wúyì zhēngbiàn nǐ de lǐlùn.
无意.e: I have no intention in arguing about your theory.

卵.e: Salmon lay their eggs in fresh water.

更改.p: Nín de mìmǎ yǐ bèi gēnggǎi.

撰写.s: 数学是神用来撰写宇宙的语言。
撰写.p: Shùxué shì shén yònglái zhuànxiě yǔzhòu de yǔyán.
撰写.e: Mathematics is the language with which God has written the universe.

巨人.s: 独眼巨人有多少个眼睛？
巨人.e: How many eyes had the Cyclops?

好心.s: 他好心地把我送到医院。
好心.p: Tā hǎoxīn de bǎ wǒ sòng dào yīyuàn.
好心.e: He was kind enough to take me to the hospital.

缺席.s: 告诉我他为什么缺席了。
缺席.p: Gàosù wǒ tā wèishénme quēxí le.
缺席.e: Tell me why he was absent.

笨蛋.p: Tā de nánpéngyou shì gè bèndàn.

社团.e: Do you take part in any community activities?

殴打.p: Tā bèi ōudǎ de kuài sǐ.
殴打.e: He was beaten to within an inch of his life.

瞒.p: Nǐ shìbúshì mán zhe wǒ shénme?

料理.e: I am fond of Australian food.

首饰.s: 先生小姐，你们买点什么首饰？
首饰.p: Xiānsheng xiǎojie, nǐmen mǎi diǎn shénme shǒushì?
首饰.e: Sir and Miss, what type of jewellery are you looking to buy?

吸毒.p: Nǐ shìbúshì xīdú xī shǎ le?
吸毒.e: Do you have a drug problem?

拳头.p: Tāngmǔ wò jǐn le tā de quántou.

滥用.e: We can only abuse of things that are good.

无私.s: 我对她的大公无私怀有敬意。
无私.p: Wǒ duì tā de dàgōngwúsī huáiyǒu jìngyì.

打量.s: 他把我从头到脚打量了一番。
打量.p: Tā bǎ wǒ cóngtóudàojiǎo dǎliang le yì fān.
打量.e: He looked me over from head to foot.

颠覆.s: 那些想要颠覆这个世界的人们，我们将击败你们。
颠覆.p: Nàxiē xiǎngyào diānfù zhège shìjiè de rénmen, wǒmen jiàng jībài nǐmen.
颠覆.e: To those who would tear the world down: we will defeat you.

应邀.s: 如果我当时有空，我一定会应邀的。
应邀.p: Rúguǒ wǒ dāngshí yǒukòng, wǒ yídìng huì yìngyāo de.
应邀.e: If I were free, I would accept your invitation.

过错.p: Wèn rén ér zhī, bìngfēi guòcuò.
过错.e: There is nothing wrong with knowledge obtained by asking.

失控.e: Things are getting out of control.

经受.p: Tā jīngshòu de gòu duō le.

焦急.s: 我焦急地在等着去聚会。
焦急.p: Wǒ jiāojí de zài děng zhe qù jùhuì.
焦急.e: I'm looking forward to the party.

演技.p: Tā de yǎnjì juéduì yǒu xiácī.
演技.e: His acting is far from being perfect.

破碎.e: The shell of an egg is easily broken.

学说.s: 约翰·道尔顿是原子学说的创始人
学说.p: Yuēhàn· Dàoěrdùn shì yuánzǐ xuéshuō de chuàngshǐrén
学说.e: John Dalton was the creator of the atomic theory.

黎明.s: 他们在黎明前控制住了火势。
黎明.p: Tāmen zài límíng qián kòngzhì zhù le huǒshì.
黎明.e: It was before dawn that they got the fire under control.

示意.e: Father gestured to me to leave the room.

长相.p: Tā de zhǎngxiàng yǔ niánlíng bùfú.

显露.s: 他的口音显露出他是外国人。
显露.p: Tā de kǒuyīn xiǎnlùchū tā shì wàiguórén.
显露.e: His accent suggests he is a foreigner.

神仙.p: Shénxiān zhǐ zài tónghuà lǐ cúnzài.
神仙.e: Fairies exist only in fairy tales.

开除.e: We've decided not to fire you.

开张.s: 你的新商店什么时候开张？
开张.p: Nǐ de xīn shāngdiàn shénmeshíhou kāizhāng?
开张.e: When does your new store open?

解脱.p: Sǐ shì wéiyì de jiětuō ma?

专职.p: Tā shì yí wèi zhuānzhí yáyī.
专职.e: He is a dentist by profession.

揍.p: Tāngmǔ bèi yì zhǐ huīxióng zòu le.
揍.e: Tom was attacked by a grizzly bear.

平行.s: 平行四边形的对边平行。
平行.e: The opposite sides of a parallelogram are parallel.

泛滥.e: The rivers were flooded by the heavy rain.

空虚.s: 没有他我的生活是空虚的。
空虚.p: Méiyǒu tā wǒ de shēnghuó shì kōngxū de.
空虚.e: My life is hollow without him.

正宗.p: Fǎguó yǒu zhèngzōng de zhōngcān ma?
正宗.e: Are there authentic Chinese restaurants in France?

惊奇.p: Tā jīngqí de kàn zhe wǒ.
惊奇.e: He looked at me in surprise.

追赶.e: Tom did his best to catch up.

宝石.e: The diamond is a precious stone.

思索.s: 汤姆不假思索脱口而出。

见解.s: 应该做什么，我和他的见解不同。
见解.p: Yīnggāi zuò shénme, wǒ hé tā de jiànjiě bùtóng.
见解.e: My view was different from his as to what should be done.

衷心.e: I thank you with all my heart.

揽.s: 她总是把责任往自己身上揽。
揽.p: Tā zǒngshì bǎ zérèn wǎng zìjǐ shēnshang lǎn.

农历.e: Spring Festival is also known as Chinese New Year.

创始人.s: 约翰·道尔顿是原子学说的创始人
创始人.p: Yuēhàn· Dàoěrdùn shì yuánzǐ xuéshuō de chuàngshǐrén
创始人.e: John Dalton was the creator of the atomic theory.

预言.e: She has a gift for prophecy.

新手.p: Tā mǎi le yì shuāng xīnshǒu tào.
新手.e: He bought a new pair of gloves.

乐意.p: Wèishénme bù ne? Wǒ hěn lèyì.
乐意.e: Why not? I'd be happy to.

苦难.s: 你遇到苦难的时候，朋友们可以帮助你经受住。
苦难.p: Nǐ yùdào kǔnàn de shíhou, péngyou men kěyǐ bāngzhù nǐ jīngshòu zhù.
苦难.e: When you encounter difficulties, friends can help you deal with them.

百合.p: Huāyuán lǐ quán shì zǐ bǎihé.
百合.e: The garden was full of purple lilies.

喇叭.s: 火车在快到交叉路口的时候减速、按喇叭。
喇叭.p: Huǒchē zài kuài dào jiāochā lùkǒu de shíhou jiǎnsù, àn lǎba.
喇叭.e: The train slowed and blared its horn as it approached the railway crossing.

报销.s: 你们学校真好，还帮你们报销来回的机票。
报销.p: Nǐmen xuéxiào zhēn hǎo, hái bāng nǐmen bàoxiāo láihuí de jīpiào.
报销.e: Your school is so kind to reimburse you for the return airfare.

可恶.s: 可恶，家的钥匙到底放哪去了?
可恶.p: Kěwù, jiāde yàoshi dàodǐ fàng nǎ qù le?
可恶.e: Shit, where the fuck did I put my home keys?

公用.s: 请问最近的公用电话在哪里?
公用.p: Qǐngwèn zuìjìn de gōngyòngdiànhuà zài nǎlǐ?
公用.e: Can you please tell me where the nearest public telephone is?

轰动.s: 披头士的发型引起了轰动。
轰动.p: Pītóushì de fàxíng yǐnqǐ le hōngdòng.
轰动.e: The hair style of the Beatles created a sensation.

废物.s: 那些一无是处的废物被炒了。
废物.p: Nàxiē yìwúshìchù de fèiwù bèi chǎo le.

解散.e: The prime minister dissolved the Diet.

海滩.s: 海滩上你到底愿意去吗？
海滩.p: Hǎitān shàng nǐ dàodǐ yuànyì qù ma?
海滩.e: Are you willing to go to the beach?

宁可.s: 我宁可死，也不想看见你哭。
宁可.p: Wǒ nìngkě sǐ, yě bùxiǎng kànjiàn nǐ kū.
宁可.e: I'd rather die than see you cry.

自在.s: 得了！你弄得她不自在了！
自在.p: Déle! Nǐ nòng de tā búzìzai le!
自在.e: Stop it! You're making her feel uncomfortable!

知己.e: A real friend is like a rare bird.

声誉.s: 丑闻让他付出了失去声誉的代价。
声誉.p: Chǒuwén ràng tā fùchū le shīqù shēngyù de dàijià.
声誉.e: That scandal cost him his reputation.

限定.s: 在限定时间内完成任务是一个职员的基本素质。
限定.p: Zài xiàndìng shíjiān nèi wánchéng rènwu shì yìge zhíyuán de jīběn sùzhì.
限定.e: It is a basic quality of an employee to complete his tasks within a fixed time.

务必.s: 请务必确认门是锁着的。
务必.p: Qǐng wùbì quèrèn mén shì suǒ zhe de.
务必.e: Please make sure that the door is locked.

着想.p: Tāngmǔ wánquán shì wèi nǐ zhuóxiǎng.

设法.s: 我们必须设法打破这个僵局。
设法.p: Wǒmen bìxū shèfǎ dǎpò zhège jiāngjú.
设法.e: We must try to break the deadlock.

订购.s: 我从美国订购了一些新书。
订购.p: Wǒ cóng Měiguó dìnggòu le yìxiē xīn shū.
订购.e: I ordered some new books from America.

过瘾.s: 去年夏天，我们在桥上看焰火看得很过瘾。
过瘾.p: Qùnián xiàtiān, wǒmen zài qiáo shàng kàn yànhuǒ kàn dehěn guòyǐn.
过瘾.e: We enjoyed watching the fireworks on a bridge last summer.

仪表.s: 汤姆把他的太阳镜留在我的车的仪表板上了。
仪表.p: Tāngmǔ bǎ tā de tàiyángjìng liú zài wǒ de chē de yíbiǎo bǎn shàng le.
仪表.e: Tom left his sunglasses on the dashboard of my car.

帐篷.s: 学校会提供帐篷给我们。
帐篷.p: Xuéxiào huì tígōng zhàngpeng gěi wǒmen.
帐篷.e: The school will provide tents for us.

泄露.s: 在这点上他泄露了秘密。
泄露.p: Zài zhè diǎn shàng tā xièlù le mìmì.
泄露.e: He let out the secret regarding this matter.

余地.s: 那时我没有选择的余地。
余地.p: Nàshí wǒ méiyǒu xuǎnzé de yúdì.

误导.s: 这是一个误导性的标题。
误导.p: Zhè shì yìge wùdǎo xìng de biāotí.

取暖.s: 这个取暖装置用柴油作为燃料。
取暖.p: Zhège qǔnuǎn zhuāngzhì yòng cháiyóu zuòwéi ránliào.
取暖.e: This heating equipment uses diesel as fuel.

发誓.s: 我能发誓这箱子里有东西。
发誓.p: Wǒ néng fāshì zhè xiāngzi lǐ yǒu dōngxī.
发誓.e: I could swear there's something inside this box.

顶尖.s: 英国所有的顶尖球队都在超级联赛中。
顶尖.p: Yīngguó suǒyǒu de dǐngjiān qiúduì dōu zài chāojí liánsài zhōng.
顶尖.e: All the top teams of the UK are in the premier division.

捍卫.p: Wǒ huì hànwèi wǒ de yuánzé.

刻苦.e: He's even more hardworking than you are.

挪.s: 把椅子挪一挪靠近桌子。
挪.p: Bǎ yǐzi nuó yì nuó kàojìn zhuōzi.
挪.e: Move the chair nearer to the desk.

茫茫.s: 突然，从茫茫大雾中出现了一艘船。
茫茫.p: Tūrán, cóng mángmáng dàwù zhōng chūxiàn le yì sōu chuán.
茫茫.e: Suddenly, a ship appeared through the fog.

礼服.p: Nà jiàn lǐfú fēicháng shìhé tā.

预备.s: 我今晚不准备出去玩，我要预备功课。
预备.p: Wǒ jīnwǎn bùzhǔn bèi chūqù wán, wǒ yào yùbèi gōngkè.
预备.e: I don't plan to hang out tonight. I need to prepare for my lessons.

发酵.p: Jiǔ bèi fàng zài tǒng lǐ fājiào.
发酵.e: Wine is put in barrels to mature.

存活.s: 中小企业要勒紧裤带才能存活。
存活.e: Small businesses will have to tighten their belts to survive.

指点.p: Qǐng nǐ gěi wǒ zhǐdiǎn yíxià.
指点.e: Can you show me the way please?

不免.s: 他是个忠厚老实的人，不免上当。
不免.p: Tā shì gè zhōnghòu lǎoshi de rén, bùmiǎn shàngdàng.
不免.e: He is an honest person, and he will always be lied to.

私下.s: 他私下给我看了她的照片。
私下.p: Tā sīxià gěi wǒ kàn le tā de zhàopiàn.
私下.e: He showed me her picture in private.

丸子.s: 章鱼小丸子真的很美味！

瀑布.s: 我看见那儿有个很美的瀑布。
瀑布.p: Wǒ kànjiàn nàr yǒu gè hěn Měidí pùbù.
瀑布.e: I saw a wonderful fall there.

证人.s: 你曾是一宗司法案件的证人？
证人.p: Nǐ zēng shì yì zōng sīfǎ ànjiàn de zhèngrén?
证人.e: Have you ever served as a witness in a court case?

时髦.s: 虽然时髦一点，但是价钱太大！
时髦.p: Suīrán shímáo yìdiǎn, dànshì jiàqian tài dà!
时髦.e: It's kind of in vogue, but the price is too much!

脱颖而出.e: Wearing a suit, he stood out.

巴掌.p: Wǒ xiǎng guò shàn nǐ yì bāzhang.

腐蚀.e: The acid ate into the metal.

友人.s: 所谓陌生人，只是还未相见的友人而已。
友人.p: Suǒwèi mòshēngrén, zhǐshì hái wèi xiāngjiàn de yǒurén éryǐ.
友人.e: A stranger is just a friend that you haven't met yet.

赢家.e: It is good to be a winner.

和解.p: Xiànzài wò gè shǒu héjiě ba.
和解.e: Now shake hands and make up.

抵挡.s: 没有男人能够抵挡女人的诱惑。
抵挡.p: Méiyǒu nánrén nénggòu dǐdǎng nǚrén de yòuhuò.
抵挡.e: No man can resist the lure of a woman.

堕落.e: You don't have to kick yourself.

奇特.p: Wǒ mǔqīn shì gè qítè de rén.

好比.e: It is like looking for a needle in a haystack.

巧合.p: Yěxǔ zhè zhǐshì yì chǎng qiǎohé.
巧合.e: Maybe it was just a coincidence.

时节.e: The cherry blossoms are at their best.

察觉.p: Biànhuà tài xiǎo, chájué bù chūlái.
察觉.e: The change is too small to be observed.

茫然.e: He was standing there with a vacant look.

虐待.e: He was treated with great cruelty.

抵御.s: 他们抵御入侵者，保卫了国家。
抵御.p: Tāmen dǐyù rùqīnzhě, bǎowèi le guójiā.
抵御.e: They defended their country against the invaders.

钱财.s: 他在银行里有大量钱财。
钱财.p: Tā zài yínháng lǐ yǒu dàliàng qiáncái.
钱财.e: He has plenty of money in the bank.

狐狸.s: 我们设了个陷阱来抓狐狸。
狐狸.p: Wǒmen shè le gè xiànjǐng lái zhuā húli.
狐狸.e: We set a trap to catch a fox.

沐浴.e: The hills are bathed in sunlight.

勾结.s: 在这个时候，体育世界应当减少犯罪组织的勾结。
勾结.p: Zài zhège shíhou, tǐyù shìjiè yīngdāng jiǎnshǎo fànzuì zǔzhī de gōujié.
勾结.e: The sports world should, at this time, eliminate the collusion with criminal organizations.

绳子.s: 那个溺水的男人抓紧了绳子。
绳子.p: Nàge nìshuǐ de nánrén zhuājǐn le shéngzi.
绳子.e: The drowning man grasped at the rope.

知足.e: Everybody knows that happiness is in contentment.

间断.s: 我们可以把间断平衡理论应用到语言上。
间断.p: Wǒmen kěyǐ bǎ jiànduàn pínghéng lǐlùn yìngyòng dào yǔyán shàng.
间断.e: We could apply the theory of punctuated equilibrium to languages.

种族.e: People are concerned about racial problems.

过量.e: Tom died of a drug overdose.

敞开.e: I just need to get something off my chest.

直觉.s: 他凭直觉发现她在撒谎。
直觉.p: Tā píng zhíjué fāxiàn tā zài sāhuǎng.
直觉.e: By intuition he knew she was lying.

本性.e: A leopard never changes its spots.

反感.s: 无理由乱发脾气会让别人反感。
反感.p: Wúlǐ yóu luàn fāpíqì huì ràng biéren fǎngǎn.
反感.e: Losing your temper for no reason would invite the resentment of others.

舔.s: 生活就像是舔仙人掌上的蜂蜜。
舔.p: Shēnghuó jiù xiàng shì tiǎn xiānrénzhǎng shàng de fēngmì.
舔.e: Life is like licking honey off a cactus.

延误.s: 由于火车延误，我迟到了。
延误.p: Yóuyú huǒchē yánwù, wǒ chídào le.
延误.e: I was late as a result of the train delay.

冷战.e: The Cold War ended when the Soviet Union collapsed.

钞票.p: Zhè zhāng chāopiào shì jiǎzào de.

终生.s: 我的终生目标是成为一名作家。
终生.p: Wǒ de zhōngshēng mùbiāo shì chéngwéi yì míngzuò jiā.
终生.e: My goal in life is to be a novelist.

斗志.s: 他的胸中还有足够的斗志。
斗志.p: Tā de xiōngzhōng háiyǒu zúgòu de dòuzhì.
斗志.e: He had plenty of fight left in him.

海盗.s: 这张地图是海盗的地图。
海盗.p: Zhè zhāng dìtú shì hǎidào de dìtú.
海盗.e: This map is a pirate map.

螃蟹.s: 第一个吃螃蟹的人一定也吃过蜘蛛。
螃蟹.p: Dìyī gè chī pángxiè de rén yídìng yě chī guò zhīzhū.
螃蟹.e: The first person who ate crab must also have tried to eat a spider.

如一.e: A picture is worth a thousand words.

辛勤.s: 我习惯辛勤努力地工作。
辛勤.p: Wǒ xíguàn xīnqín nǔlì de gōngzuò.
辛勤.e: I am accustomed to working hard.

预见.s: 卓别林是有预见力的人。
预见.p: Zhuóbiélín shì yǒu yùjiàn lì de rén.

清澈.s: 你的歌声像太平洋的海水一样清澈。
清澈.p: Nǐ de gēshēng xiàng TàipíngYáng de hǎishuǐ yíyàng qīngchè.
清澈.e: You sing with a voice as clear as the waters of the Pacific Ocean.

敏锐.s: 她因为敏锐的观察力，很适合当一名摄影师。
敏锐.p: Tā yīnwèi mǐnruì de guānchálì, hěn shìhé dāng yì míng shèyǐngshī.
敏锐.e: Her acute observation skills make her a very suitable photographer.

关切.s: 公众意见的平衡仍是他的关切。
关切.p: Gōngzhòngyìjiàn de pínghéng réng shì tā de guānqiè.
关切.e: The balance of public opinion remains in his favor.

软弱.s: 我们软弱的反对派不足以阻止他。
软弱.p: Wǒmen ruǎnruò de fǎnduìpài bùzú yǐ zǔzhǐ tā.
软弱.e: Our feckless opposition party didn't do enough to stop him.

穿梭.s: 穿梭班车到机场需要多长时间？
穿梭.p: Chuānsuō bānchē dào jīchǎng xūyào duō cháng shíjiān?
穿梭.e: How long does it take for the airport shuttle to get to the airport?

触动.s: 他悲伤的故事触动了我的心。
触动.p: Tā bēishāng de gùshì chùdòng le wǒ de xīn.
触动.e: His sad story touched my heart.

明智.p: Tā de zhōnggào zǒngshì hěn míngzhì.
明智.e: His advice is always very sensible.

造假.s: 学术造假比你想象的普遍。
造假.p: Xuéshù zàojiǎ bǐ nǐ xiǎngxiàng de pǔbiàn.
造假.e: Academic fraud is more common than you might think.

典范.s: 我该说，他的行为是典范。
典范.p: Wǒ gāi shuō, tā de xíngwéi shì diǎnfàn.
典范.e: I must say, his behaviour is exemplary.

黄昏.s: 她说她黄昏之前必须回来。
黄昏.p: Tā shuō tā huánghūn zhīqián bìxū huílai.
黄昏.e: She said that she had to be back before dawn.

奴隶.e: Don't be a slave to money.

日程.s: 请让我看一下日程安排！
日程.p: Qǐng ràng wǒ kàn yíxià rìchéng ānpái!

蜡烛.s: 你记得自己该买蜡烛吗？
蜡烛.p: Nǐ jìde zìjǐ gāi mǎi làzhú ma?
蜡烛.e: Did you remember that you were supposed to buy candles?

精神病.s: 过于上网不是跟医学或精神病有关的事情。
精神病.p: Guòyú shàngwǎng búshì gēn yīxué huò jīngshénbìng yǒuguān de shìqing.
精神病.e: Excessive use of the Internet is not a medical or psychiatric issue.

善意.s: 通往地狱的路，都是由善意铺成的。
善意.p: Tōngwǎng dìyù de lù, dōu shì yóu shànyì pū chéng de.
善意.e: The road to hell is paved with good intentions.

审视.e: Take a better look at yourself.

名声.p: Wǒ dǔ shàng wǒ de míngshēng.
名声.e: I'll stake my reputation on it.

疏散.s: 人们因为洪水被疏散了。
疏散.p: Rénmen yīnwèi hóngshuǐ bèi shūsǎn le.
疏散.e: The people were evacuated because of the flood.

独一无二.s: 这里的天气有独一无二的特点。
独一无二.p: Zhèlǐ de tiānqì yǒu dúyìwúèr de tèdiǎn.
独一无二.e: The weather here has its own unique characteristics.

谣言.s: 谣言最后被证明是假的。
谣言.p: Yáoyán zuìhòu bèi zhèngmíng shì jiǎ de.
谣言.e: The rumor turned out to be false.

嚼.p: Tā zài jiáo kǒuxiāngtáng, shì ma?

围墙.s: 她太矮了，看不到围墙外面。
围墙.p: Tā tài ǎi le, kàn búdào wéiqiáng wàimiàn.
围墙.e: She was too short to see over the fence.

玩耍.p: Wǒmen kàn zhe zhè háizi wánshuǎ.
玩耍.e: We were watching the child at play.

浮现.s: 一个绝妙的想法浮现在他的脑海。
浮现.p: Yìge juémiào de xiǎngfǎ fúxiàn zài tā de nǎohǎi.
浮现.e: A magnificent idea materialized in front of him.

贩卖.s: 她在演唱会的场地贩卖毒品。
贩卖.p: Tā zài yǎnchànghuì de chǎngdì fànmài dúpǐn.

恐龙.s: 恐龙好久以前就灭绝了。
恐龙.p: Kǒnglóng hǎojiǔ yǐqián jiù mièjué le.
恐龙.e: Dinosaurs died out a very long time ago.

贬值.s: 随着通货膨胀的发展美元贬值了。
贬值.p: Suízhe tōnghuòpéngzhàng de fāzhǎn měiyuán biǎnzhí le.
贬值.e: The value of the dollar declines as the rate of inflation rises.

倒塌.p: Qiáo zài zhòngyā zhīxià dǎotā le.
倒塌.e: The bridge crashed under the pressure.

整洁.s: 他的房间总是那么整洁干净。
整洁.p: Tā de fángjiān zǒngshì nàme zhěngjié gānjìng.

物种.s: 这是一个濒临灭绝的物种。
物种.p: Zhè shì yìge bīnlín mièjué de wùzhǒng.

理所当然.s: 她理所当然的取得了胜利。
理所当然.p: Tā lǐsuǒdāngrán de qǔdé le shènglì.

投身.s: 她热忱地投身于这份光荣的事业。
投身.p: Tā rèchén de tóushēn yú zhè fèn guāngróng de shìyè.
投身.e: He enthusiastically engaged himself in this honorable undertaking.

环绕.p: Zhè zuò chéngshì bèi qúnshān huánrào.
环绕.e: The mountains were all around the city.

衰退.s: 我们不能愁闷地看着这个城市就这样衰退下去。
衰退.p: Wǒmen bùnéng chóumèn de kàn zhe zhège chéngshì jiù zhèyàng shuāituì xiàqù.
衰退.e: We can't just look on dejectedly while this city continues to go into decline.

迷惑.s: 她告诉了我她很迷惑的。
迷惑.p: Tā gàosù le wǒ tā hěn míhuo de.
迷惑.e: She told me that she's puzzled.

电线.e: The puppets are controlled by wires.

分辨.s: 是非对错，有时很难分辨。
分辨.p: Shìfēi duì cuò, yǒushí hěn nán fēnbiàn.
分辨.e: It is sometimes hard to tell right from wrong.

攒.s: 我工作是为了攒大学学费。
攒.p: Wǒ gōngzuò shì wèile cuán dàxué xuéfèi.
攒.e: I am working to save for my college tuition.

航行.s: 他们沿着非洲西岸航行了。
航行.p: Tāmen yánzhe Fēizhōu xī àn hángxíng le.
航行.e: They sailed along the west coast of Africa.

露面.s: 汤姆不敢再到这里露面。
露面.p: Tāngmǔ bù gǎn zài dào zhèlǐ lòumiàn.
露面.e: Tom wouldn't dare show his face around here again.

丧生.s: 这场爆炸中有三人丧生。
丧生.p: Zhè chǎng bàozhà zhōng yǒu sān rén sàngshēng.
丧生.e: Three people were killed in the explosion.

争端.s: 在这个城市，白人和黑人间的争端愈演愈烈。
争端.p: Zài zhège chéngshì, báirén hé hēirén jiān de zhēngduān yùyǎnyùliè.
争端.e: The conflict between blacks and whites in the city became worse.

解析.s: 不遵守命名规则会导致解析错误。
解析.p: Bù zūnshǒu mìngmíng guīzé huì dǎozhì jiěxī cuòwù.
解析.e: Not complying with the naming conventions will result in parse errors.

人造.s: 人造皮革是比不上真皮的。
人造.p: Rénzào pígé shì bǐbúshàng zhēnpí de.
人造.e: Artificial leather can't compare with the real thing.

同盟.s: 德国曾是意大利的同盟国。
同盟.p: Déguó zēng shì Yìdàlì de tóngméngguó.
同盟.e: Germany was once allied with Italy.

寂静.p: Qiǎn jiān shān xiànzài shì jìjìng de.

说谎.s: 我不相信你。你总是说谎。
说谎.p: Wǒ bù xiāngxìn nǐ. Nǐ zǒngshì shuōhuǎng.
说谎.e: I don't believe you. You're always telling lies.

安宁.s: 让我们享受这平静和安宁。
安宁.p: Ràng wǒmen xiǎngshòu zhè píngjìng hé ānníng.
安宁.e: Let's just enjoy this peace and quiet.

扰乱.s: 不要因为吃得太多而扰乱胃的正常消化。
扰乱.p: Búyào yīnwèi chī de tài duō ér rǎoluàn wèi de zhèngcháng xiāohuà.
扰乱.e: Don't eat too much and disrupt the stomach's normal digestion process.

昏.s: 在麻醉剂的作用下，他昏了过去。
昏.p: Zài mázuìjì de zuòyòng xià, tā hūn le guòqù.
昏.e: He lost consciousness under the influence of the anesthetic.

悠闲.s: 假期里，我度过了悠闲的日子。
悠闲.p: Jiàqī lǐ, wǒ dùguò le yōuxián de rìzi.
悠闲.e: I spent idle days during the vacation.

一连.p: Tā yìlián sì tiān wòbìng zài chuáng.
一连.e: He was ill in bed for four days straight.

悲惨.s: 这个故事有一个悲惨的结局。
悲惨.p: Zhège gùshì yǒu yìge bēicǎn de jiéjú.
悲惨.e: This story has a sad ending.

会面.s: 两国代表团在日内瓦会面。
会面.e: The delegations of both countries met in Geneva.

窗帘.p: Chuānglián shǐ fángjiān biàn piàoliang le.
窗帘.e: The curtains make this room beautiful.

出众.e: He's a man of outstanding character.

富翁.e: Who wants to be a millionaire?

赤字.e: We went into the red last year.

报仇.s: 你杀了我的父亲，今天我要报仇。
报仇.p: Nǐ shā le wǒ de fùqīn, jīntiān wǒ yào bàochóu.
报仇.e: You killed my father. Today, I want revenge.

哨.s: 会场内，掌声、哨声、喊声、笑声乱成了一锅粥。
哨.p: Huìchǎng nèi, zhǎngshēng, shào shēng, hǎnshēng, xiàoshēng luàn chéngle yìguōzhōu.
哨.e: Inside the venue, sounds of clapping, whistling, yelling, laughing blended together.

总和.e: She was always quarreling with her parents.

海湾.s: 我们得到了在这个海湾内捕鱼的特权。
海湾.p: Wǒmen dédào le zài zhège hǎiwān nèi bǔyú de tèquán.
海湾.e: We were granted the privilege of fishing in this bay.

雕刻.s: 这座雕像是由樱木雕刻而成。
雕刻.p: Zhè zuò diāoxiàng shì yóu yīng mù diāokè ér chéng.
雕刻.e: The statue was carved from a block of cherry wood.

别看.e: Don't read that kind of book.

编织.e: She was busy with her knitting.

迫不及待.s: 他迫不及待地想要知道结果。
迫不及待.p: Tā pòbùjídài de xiǎngyào zhīdào jiēguǒ.
迫不及待.e: He is anxious to know the result.

马桶.s: 手机如同马桶一样被细菌污染。
马桶.p: Shǒujī rútóng mǎtǒng yíyàng bèi xìjūn wūrǎn.
马桶.e: A cell phone is as contaminated with bacteria as a toilet is.

隐约.s: 透过薄雾，我隐约看见了我的未来。
隐约.p: Tòuguò bówù, wǒ yǐnyuē kànjiàn le wǒ de wèilái.
隐约.e: In looking through the mist, I caught a glimpse of my future.

趁机.s: 因为今天明天我休息，所以趁机会快点搬好它。
趁机.p: Yīnwèi jīntiān míngtiān wǒ xiūxi, suǒyǐ chènjī huì kuàidiǎn bān hǎo tā.
趁机.e: I don't have to go to work today and tomorrow, so I will use the opportunity to quickly finish moving it.

南瓜.s: 这个菜谱需要一些青南瓜。
南瓜.p: Zhège càipǔ xūyào yìxiē qīng nánguā.

沸腾.e: Water turns into steam when it is boiled.

信件.p: Tā rēng le hěn duō jiù xìnjiàn.
信件.e: He threw away a bunch of old letters.

坦白.s: 坦白地说，我不喜欢你的发型。
坦白.p: Tǎnbái de shuō, wǒ bù xǐhuan nǐ de fàxíng.
坦白.e: Frankly speaking, I don't like your haircut.

美德.p: Chéngshí shì zuì zhòngyào de měidé.

反驳.s: 他们认为，去反驳一个不认识的人有些不礼貌。
反驳.p: Tāmen rènwéi, qù fǎnbó yìge bú rènshi de rén yǒuxiē bù lǐmào.
反驳.e: They consider it impolite to disagree with someone they don't know very well.

全力以赴.s: 我们全力以赴来完成工作。
全力以赴.e: We went all out to get the job done.

探险.e: They went on an expedition to the Antarctic.

倚.s: 他倚著我的肩膀睡著了。
倚.p: Tā yǐ zhù wǒ de jiānbǎng shuì zhù le.
倚.e: He fell asleep on my shoulder.

风筝.p: Yǒu yì zhǐ fēngzheng zài shù shàng.
风筝.e: There is a kite flying above the tree.

简短.p: Wǒmen jiǎnduǎn de tán le tán.

追随.s: 汤姆想追随他父亲的脚步。
追随.p: Tāngmǔ xiǎng zhuīsuí tā fùqīn de jiǎobù.
追随.e: Tom wanted to follow in his father's footsteps.

厌倦.p: Wǒ yànjuàn le wǒ de gōngzuò.
厌倦.e: I am tired of my work.

忠于.e: To whom are you loyal: me or the king?

抚摸.p: Tā zài fǔmō nà zhǐ gǒu.

野心.p: Tā shì gè hěn yǒu yěxīn de rén.
野心.e: He was a man of great ambition.

乞丐.s: 他很富有，但活得像个乞丐。
乞丐.p: Tā hěn fùyǒu, dàn huó de xiàng gè qǐgài.
乞丐.e: He is rich yet he lives like a beggar.

飞翔.e: The birds soar in the air.

抽签.p: Lái chōuqiān juédìng shéi xiān zǒu ba.
抽签.e: Let's draw lots to decide who goes first.

庄严.s: 一个神圣的仪式在庄严的庙宇中举行。
庄严.p: Yìge shénshèng de yíshì zài zhuāngyán de miàoyǔ zhòngjǔ xíng.
庄严.e: A sacred ritual took place in the magnificent temple.

雇员.s: 这个公司三分之二的雇员是工程师。
雇员.p: Zhège gōngsī sānfēn zhī èr de gùyuán shì gōngchéngshī.
雇员.e: Two thirds of the employees of this company are engineers.

无能.s: 老公性无能，我该怎么办？
无能.p: Lǎogōng xìng wúnéng, wǒ gāi zěnmebàn?
无能.e: What should I do if my husband is impotent?

苍蝇.e: There's a fly in the noodle broth.

情愿.s: 他不情愿地启动引擎开车走了。
情愿.p: Tā bùqíngyuàn de qǐdòng yǐnqíng kāichē zǒu le.
情愿.e: Reluctantly, he started the engine and drove off.

蒸发.e: Boiling water evaporates and turns into a gas.

一连串.s: 一连串的爆炸使实验室成为废墟。
一连串.p: Yìliánchuàn de bàozhà shǐ shíyànshì chéngwéi fèixū.
一连串.e: A series of blasts reduced the laboratory to ruins.

溅.p: Tāngmǔ hé wǒ jiàn le duìfāng.
溅.e: Tom and I splashed each other.

狂热.s: 我的哥哥是很狂热的足球迷。
狂热.p: Wǒ dīgē gē shì hěn kuángrè de zúqiúmí.
狂热.e: My older brother is a very enthusiastic soccer fan.

辜负.s: 她没有辜负我们的期望。
辜负.p: Tā méiyǒu gūfù wǒmen de qīwàng.
辜负.e: She lived up to our expectations.

警报.s: 这是警报：洪水就要来了。
警报.p: Zhè shì jǐngbào: hóngshuǐ jiùyào lái le.
警报.e: This was a warning: the floods were coming.

评判.e: He judges other people time and again.

打捞.s: 船的残骸从海底被打捞上来。
打捞.p: Chuán de cánhái cóng hǎidǐ bèi dǎlāo shànglái.
打捞.e: The wreckage of the ship was salvaged after it had gone to Davy Jones's locker.

昼夜.s: 这段时间昼夜温差很大。
昼夜.p: Zhè duàn shíjiān zhòuyè wēnchā hěn dà.
昼夜.e: There is a large temperature difference between day and night during this period of time.

晚年.s: 我的外公想安静地度过晚年。
晚年.p: Wǒ de wàigōng xiǎng ānjìng de dùguò wǎnnián.
晚年.e: My grandfather wants to live quietly for the rest of his life.

宽敞.p: Wǒ xīn jiāde kètīng hěn kuānchang.
宽敞.e: The living room in my new house is very large.

猜想.p: Wǒ cāixiǎng nǐ kěnéng shì duì de.
猜想.e: You could be right, I suppose.

架子.e: The cup is on the shelf.

言行.e: Your words must correspond with your actions.

上火.s: “你为什么跑这么快？”—“我得上火车。”
上火.p: "Nǐ wèishénme pǎo zhème kuài?"—"Wǒ de shànghuǒ chē."
上火.e: "Why are you running so fast?" "I have to catch the train."

合伙.e: We have reached a partnership agreement.

江山.e: A leopard never changes its spots.

火花.e: A spark caused the gunpowder to explode.

讨好.s: 他竭尽全力地讨好他老婆。
讨好.p: Tā jiéjìnquánlì de tǎohǎo tā lǎopó.
讨好.e: He bent over backward to please his wife.

交接.s: 在他们双目交接的瞬间，世界仿佛静止了。
交接.p: Zài tāmen shuāng mù jiāojiē de shùnjiān, shìjiè fǎngfú jìngzhǐ le.
交接.e: When their eyes met, it was as if the world stood still.

望远镜.s: 你可以用望远镜看星星。
望远镜.p: Nǐ kěyǐ yòng wàngyuǎnjìng kàn xīngxing.
望远镜.e: You can use a telescope to look at the stars.

抚养.p: Tā shì zěnme fǔyǎng háizi de?
抚养.e: How does she bring up her children?

非得.s: 他们那时非得把农场卖掉吗?
非得.p: Tāmen nàshí fēiděi bǎ nóngchǎng màidiào ma?
非得.e: Need they have sold the farm?

行星.s: 行星围着固定不动的恒星转。
行星.p: Xíngxīng wéi zhe gùdìng búdòng de héngxīng zhuǎn.
行星.e: Planets move around a fixed star.

田园.s: 咱们到田园去放风筝怎么样？
田园.p: Zánmen dào tiányuán qù fàngfēngzheng zěnmeyàng?
田园.e: Let's go to the field and fly kites, what do you say?

挽.s: 我看见他们胳膊挽着胳膊地走路。
挽.p: Wǒ kànjiàn tāmen gēbo wǎn zhe gēbo de zǒulù.
挽.e: I saw them walking arm in arm.

耳光.p: Tā gěi le tā yìge ěrguāng.
耳光.e: She slapped him in the face.

挑剔.p: Wǒ bù tiāoti, wǒ shénme dōu chī.
挑剔.e: I'm not picky. I'll eat anything.

倔强.p: Tā shì gè juéjiàng de rén.

指纹.e: Did the police find any fingerprints?

接手.s: 他接手了他父亲的公司。
接手.p: Tā jiēshǒu le tā fùqīn de gōngsī.
接手.e: He has taken over his father's business.

偏离.s: 现代人已经偏离上帝和自然了。
偏离.p: Xiàndàirén yǐjīng piānlí Shàngdì hé zìrán le.
偏离.e: Modern man has moved far away from God and from nature.

耗费.s: 整个过程需要耗费数月。
耗费.e: The whole process will take months.

思绪.p: Gōngzuò zhīqián xiān shōu hǎo sīxù.
思绪.e: Collect your thoughts before you begin your work.

悲痛.s: 这表明幸福和悲痛之间只隔着看法。
悲痛.p: Zhè biǎomíng xìngfú hé bēitòng zhījiān zhǐ gé zhe kànfǎ.
悲痛.e: This shows that happiness and sadness are only separated by attitude.

中立.s: 瑞士是一个中立的国家。
中立.p: Ruìshì shì yìge zhōnglì de guójiā.

值钱.e: The frame itself is worth more than the picture.

雇佣.p: Tā gùyōng wǒ lái bāngzhù tā.
雇佣.e: She hired me to help her.

俗称.e: Celebrating Spring Festival is commonly referred to as 'passing the year'.

监护.s: 我把自己当成你的监护人。
监护.p: Wǒ bǎ zìjǐ dàngchéng nǐ de jiānhùrén.
监护.e: I regard myself as your guardian.

星级.s: 我打算去五星级酒店住。
星级.p: Wǒ dǎsuàn qù wǔxīngjí jiǔdiàn zhù.
星级.e: I intend to stay at a five-star hotel.

双胞胎.s: 这对双胞胎长得一模一样。
双胞胎.e: Those twins look like two peas in a pod.

末日.e: When will the world come to an end?

成型.s: 我们夏天的计划成型了。
成型.p: Wǒmen xiàtiān de jìhuà chéngxíng le.
成型.e: Our plans for the summer are taking shape.

唤醒.s: 被闹钟唤醒没有被鸟唤醒的好。
唤醒.p: Bèi nàozhōng huànxǐng méiyǒu bèi niǎo huànxǐng de hǎo.
唤醒.e: Much better to be woken by the birds than by an alarm.

磕.s: 他磕碎了下巴，掉了几颗牙。
磕.p: Tā kē suì le xiàba, diào le jǐ kē yá.
磕.e: He got a broken jaw and lost some teeth.

强盗.p: Zuótiān qiángdào chuǎngjìn le diàn lǐ.
强盗.e: A burglar broke into the shop yesterday.

转眼.e: He left in the blink of an eye.

入场.p: Zài nǎ néng mǎi dào rùchǎngquàn?
入场.e: Where can you buy a ticket to get in?

精髓.s: 个人自由是民主的精髓。
精髓.p: Gèrén zìyóu shì mínzhǔ de jīngsuǐ.
精髓.e: Individual freedom is the soul of democracy.

人道.s: 存在主义是一种人道主义。

往常.p: Gēn wǎngcháng yíyàng, tā lái chíle.

光顾.s: 昨晚我还没有睡觉家里就被小偷光顾了
光顾.p: Zuówǎn wǒ hái méiyǒu shuìjiào jiālǐ jiù bèi xiǎotōu guānggù le
光顾.e: Last night my house was robbed while I was still awake.

废墟.s: 这座城市成为了一片废墟。
废墟.p: Zhè zuò chéngshì chéngwéi le yí piàn fèixū.

屏蔽.s: 但愿我能找到在我的博客上屏蔽评论的办法。
屏蔽.p: Dànyuàn wǒ néng zhǎodào zài wǒ de bókè shàng píngbì pínglùn de bànfǎ.
屏蔽.e: I wish I could figure out how to disable comments on my blog.

雇主.s: 德国将禁止雇主在脸书上偷窥。
雇主.p: Déguó jiàng jìnzhǐ gùzhǔ zài Liǎnshū shàng tōukuī.
雇主.e: Germany is to ban employers from snooping on Facebook.

团聚.s: 说明年夜饭的饺子是亲人团聚的象征。
团聚.p: Shuōmíng niányèfàn de jiǎozi shì qīnrén tuánjù de xiàngzhēng.
团聚.e: This means that eating dumplings on New Year's eve is a symbol of family reunion.

私自.s: 他是个极其自私自利的人。
私自.p: Tā shì gè jíqí zìsīzìlì de rén.
私自.e: He is a lump of selfishness.

英俊.s: 我爸爸年轻的时候一定很英俊。
英俊.p: Wǒ bàba niánqīng de shíhou yídìng hěn yīngjùn.
英俊.e: My father must have been handsome in his youth.

潜伏.s: 我认为，你已经完全具备了潜伏的资质。
潜伏.p: Wǒ rènwéi, nǐ yǐjīng wánquán jùbèi le qiánfú de zīzhì.
潜伏.e: I believe you already possess all the qualities needed to go undercover.

山谷.s: 小山后面有个美丽的山谷。
山谷.p: Xiǎo shān hòumian yǒu gè měilì de shāngǔ.
山谷.e: A beautiful valley lies behind the hill.

辗转.s: 我辗转反侧，反复思考着白天发生的事，后悔不已。
辗转.p: Wǒ zhǎnzhuǎnfǎncè, fǎnfù sīkǎo zhe báitiān fāshēng de shì, hòuhuǐ bùyǐ.
辗转.e: I'm tossing and turning, repeatedly thinking about what happened today, deeply remorseful.

散落.p: Sīxiǎng de suìpiàn sǎnluò yì de.
散落.e: The shards of thought were scattered on the ground.

镶.s: 钻石被镶在一个金戒指上。
镶.p: Zuànshí bèi xiāng zài yìge jīn jièzhi shàng.
镶.e: The diamond was set in a gold ring.

半岛.e: Have you already been to the Korean Peninsula?

情调.s: 里面开了一个个欧式的小店，情调好极了！
情调.p: Lǐmiàn kāi le yígègè Ōushì de xiǎodiàn, qíngdiào hǎo jíle!

预感.s: 我的预感被证明是正确的。

淡季.s: 在旅游淡季，机票会很便宜。

菜肴.s: 希望你喜欢黎巴嫩菜肴。

养活.s: 努力工作才能养活自己。

禁不住.s: 我禁不住想他会不会准时到。

坚韧.s: 学好一门外语需要坚韧不拔的毅力。

显微镜.s: 你知道显微镜和望远镜的差别吗？
