宝藏.p: Xióngmāo yīnwèi tāmen de xīyǒu ér chéngwéi le shìjiè de bǎozàng.
宝藏.e: Because of their rarity, pandas have become a world treasure.

编程.p: Biānchéng yǔyán shì tā de àihào.

腐烂.e: This apple is starting to rot.

惊吓.s: 猴子跳到他身上的时候，他受到了惊吓。
惊吓.p: Hóuzi tiào dào tā shēnshang de shíhou, tā shòudào le jīngxià.
惊吓.e: He was scared when the monkey jumped at him.

复原.s: 我相信你很快就能复原。
复原.p: Wǒ xiāngxìn nǐ hěn kuài jiù néng fùyuán.
复原.e: I believe you'll get over it soon.

踪迹.s: 他消失了，不留一丝踪迹。
踪迹.p: Tā xiāoshī le, bù liú yì sī zōngjì.

本意.e: I didn't mean to be selfish.

管用.e: That medicine isn't going to help.

牵扯.s: 我不想被牵扯到这件事里。
牵扯.p: Wǒ bùxiǎng bèi qiānchě dào zhè jiàn shì lǐ.
牵扯.e: I don't want to be involved in that matter.

摔跤.e: The roads are slippery on a rainy day. Be careful not to fall.

卑鄙.s: 我为你的卑鄙行径感到羞耻。
卑鄙.p: Wǒ wèi nǐ de bēibǐ xíngjìng gǎndào xiūchǐ.
卑鄙.e: I am ashamed of your despicable deed.

随心所欲.e: I can do what I want.

旗袍.p: Zuìchū de qípáo shì kuānsōng de.
旗袍.e: The original qipao was wide and loose.

骨架.s: 汤姆在洞穴里找到了一具骨架。
骨架.p: Tāngmǔ zài dòngxué lǐ zhǎodào le yí jù gǔjià.
骨架.e: Tom found a skeleton in the cave.

忠告.p: Wǒ xūyào yìxiē hǎo de zhōnggào.

哭笑不得.e: I don't know whether to cry or to laugh.

失明.p: Tā zàiyì wài zhōng shīmíng le.
失明.e: He lost his eyesight in the accident.

分外.s: 先肯定后否定，一正一反，就分外有力量。
分外.p: Xiān kěndìng hòu fǒudìng, yí zhèng yì fǎn, jiù fènwài yǒulì liàng.
分外.e: First acknowledge, then deny – one for and one against – and then you are in a powerful position.

眼界.s: 再要开眼界，去看人民广场下面的地下商场。
眼界.p: Zài yào kāiyǎnjiè, qù kàn rénmín guǎngchǎng xiàmiàn de dìxià shāngchǎng.
眼界.e: To broaden your view, go see the underground shopping mall beneath People's Square.

分发.s: 你能帮我给这些人分发节目单吗？
分发.p: Nǐ néng bāng wǒ gěi zhèxiē rén fēnfā jiémù dān ma?
分发.e: Will you help me give out the programs to those people?

照常.s: 就算下雨，比赛也将照常进行。
照常.p: Jiùsuàn xiàyǔ, bǐsài yě jiàng zhàocháng jìnxíng.
照常.e: Even if it rains, the game will be played.

出走.s: 在我十岁的时候，我哥哥离家出走了。
出走.p: Zài wǒ shí suì de shíhou, wǒ gēge líjiāchūzǒu le.
出走.e: When I was 10, my brother left our home.

尾气.s: 汽车尾气在城镇里造成了严重的污染。
尾气.p: Qìchē wěiqì zài chéngzhèn lǐ zàochéng le yánzhòng de wūrǎn.
尾气.e: Car exhaust causes serious pollution in towns.

逆境.e: Adversity makes a man wise, not rich.

同仁.s: 老师应该一视同仁地对待他们的学生。
同仁.p: Lǎoshī yīnggāi yíshìtóngrén de duìdài tāmen de xuésheng.
同仁.e: Teachers should treat all their students impartially.

通缉.s: 汤姆已经上通缉令三年了。
通缉.p: Tāngmǔ yǐjīng shàng tōngjīlìng sān nián le.
通缉.e: Tom has been on the wanted list for three years.

瑕疵.p: Tā de yǎnjì juéduì yǒu xiácī.
瑕疵.e: His acting is far from being perfect.

恭敬.s: 没有人向他恭敬地鞠躬。
恭敬.p: Méiyǒu rén xiàng tā gōngjìng de jūgōng.
恭敬.e: No one respectfully bowed towards him.

勤俭.p: Tā xíguàn le qínjiǎn de shēnghuó
勤俭.e: She is used to living a hardworking and frugal life.

国学.s: 大学被招收了三个中国学生。
国学.p: Dàxué bèi zhāoshōu le sān gèzhōng guóxué shēng.
国学.e: Three Chinese students were admitted to the college.

埋葬.p: Tā máizàng le tā de dúshēngzǐ.

洞穴.e: How many caves are there in this area?

一无所有.s: 但你知道，我除了这些以外一无所有！
一无所有.p: Dàn nǐ zhīdào, wǒ chúle zhèxiē yǐwài yìwúsuǒyǒu!
一无所有.e: But you know, I have nothing aside from this.

钦佩.p: Wǒ hěn qīnpèi tā de cáigàn.
钦佩.e: I feel admiration for his talent.

傲慢.s: 我无法忍受她傲慢的态度。
傲慢.p: Wǒ wúfǎ rěnshòu tā àomàn de tàidu.
傲慢.e: I couldn't put up with her arrogant behavior.

毁坏.s: 这个国家被长期的战争毁坏了。
毁坏.p: Zhège guójiā bèi chángqī de zhànzhēng huǐhuài le.
毁坏.e: The country had been devastated by long war.

执意.s: 他执意不惜一切代价获得成功。
执意.p: Tā zhíyì bùxī yíqiè dàijià huòdé chénggōng.
执意.e: He is determined to succeed at any price.

仓促.s: 这个故事仓促地结了尾。
仓促.p: Zhège gùshì cāngcù de jiéle wěi.

名贵.p: Tā yǒu hěn duō fú míngguì de huà.

断绝.s: 他跟他们干脆地断绝来往了。
断绝.p: Tā gēn tāmen gāncuì de duànjué láiwǎng le.
断绝.e: He made a clean break with them.

灌输.s: 父母试图将诚实和工作的重要性灌输给孩子。
灌输.p: Fùmǔ shìtú jiàng chéngshí hé gōngzuò de zhòngyàoxìng guànshū gěi háizi.
灌输.e: Parents try to impress upon their children the importance of honesty and hard work.

自责.s: 他只是责怪别人，从不自责。
自责.p: Tā zhǐshì zéguài biéren, cóngbú zìzé.
自责.e: He only blames other people, and never himself.

温差.s: 这段时间昼夜温差很大。
温差.p: Zhè duàn shíjiān zhòuyè wēnchā hěn dà.
温差.e: There is a large temperature difference between day and night during this period of time.

贴切.e: The translation is quite true to the original.

鉴赏.s: 她对绘画有很好的鉴赏力。
鉴赏.p: Tā duì huìhuà yǒu hěn hǎo de jiànshǎng lì.
鉴赏.e: She's got a good eye for paintings.

阅历.s: 她年轻，天真而又缺乏阅历。
阅历.p: Tā niánqīng, tiānzhēn ér yòu quēfá yuèlì.

私立.e: Do you study at a private school?

笼子.p: Lǎohǔ tǎng zài lóngzi de zhōngjiān.
笼子.e: The tiger laid in the middle of the cage.

荒谬.s: 这是我听过最荒谬的想法。
荒谬.p: Zhè shì wǒ tīng guò zuì huāngmiù de xiǎngfǎ.
荒谬.e: That's the most absurd idea I've ever heard.

入场券.p: Zài nǎ néng mǎi dào rùchǎngquàn?
入场券.e: Where can you buy a ticket to get in?

通红.s: 我一喝了酒就立刻变得通红。
通红.p: Wǒ yì hē le jiǔ jiù lìkè biànde tōnghóng.
通红.e: The minute I have something to drink, I turn bright red.

自卫.s: 她在夜校上自卫术课程。
自卫.p: Tā zài yèxiào shàng zìwèi shù kèchéng.
自卫.e: She took night classes in the art of self-defense.

补救.s: 这种问题该有补救办法。
补救.p: Zhèzhǒng wèntí gāi yǒu bǔjiù bànfǎ.
补救.e: This type of problem should be able to be solved.

剃.s: 我已经决定把我的头发剃了。
剃.p: Wǒ yǐjīng juédìng bǎ wǒ de tóufa tì le.
剃.e: I've decided to shave my head.

轻而易举.s: 我可以轻而易举地碰到我的脚趾。
轻而易举.p: Wǒ kěyǐ qīngéryìjǔ de pèngdào wǒ de jiǎozhǐ.
轻而易举.e: I can easily touch my toes.

姓氏.e: How is your family name written?

不得而知.s: 这个计划能否成功还不得而知。
不得而知.p: Zhège jìhuà néngfǒu chénggōng hái bùdéérzhī.
不得而知.e: It is yet to be seen whether this plan will succeed or not.

慌张.s: 汤姆在表达自己的意见的时候总是很慌张。
慌张.p: Tāngmǔ zài biǎodá zìjǐ de yìjiàn de shíhou zǒngshì hěn huāngzhāng.
慌张.e: Tom never felt comfortable expressing his own opinion.

脚踏实地.p: Wǒ shì gè jiǎotàshídì de rén.
脚踏实地.e: I have my feet firmly planted on the ground.

繁多.s: 中国幅员辽阔,因而茶的品种繁多。
繁多.p: Zhōngguó fúyuán liáokuò, yīnér chá de pǐnzhǒng fánduō.
繁多.e: China's territory is vast, thus the types of tea vary.

逗留.s: 他们会坚持要她逗留久一点。
逗留.p: Tāmen huì jiānchí yào tā dòuliú jiǔ yìdiǎn.
逗留.e: They will insist on her staying there longer.

送行.p: Wǒmen zài jīchǎng wèi tā sòngxíng.
送行.e: We saw her off at the airport.

节俭.s: 凭着节俭，她设法以自己微薄的薪水生活。
节俭.p: Píngzhe jiéjiǎn, tā shèfǎ yǐ zìjǐ wēibó de xīnshuǐ shēnghuó.
节俭.e: By frugality she managed to get along on her small salary.

谋生.s: 他怎么在这样的贫困中谋生？
谋生.p: Tā zěnme zài zhèyàng de pínkùn zhōng móushēng?
谋生.e: How did he make his living in such poverty?

摇篮.p: Bǎobao zài yáolán lǐ rùshuì le.
摇篮.e: The baby fell asleep in the cradle.

锈.p: Nǐ yǒu chú xiù de dōngxī ma?
锈.e: Do you have anything to remove stains?

反常.e: There's something off about you today.

执照.s: 你还没到可以拿驾驶执照的年龄。
执照.p: Nǐ hái méi dào kěyǐ ná jiàshǐzhízhào de niánlíng.
执照.e: You're not old enough to get a driver's license.

责备.p: Wǒ zébèi guò tā hěn duōcì le.

拴.s: 汤姆把线拴在了风筝上。
拴.p: Tāngmǔ bǎ xiàn shuān zài le fēngzheng shàng.
拴.e: Tom attached the string to the kite.

甘心.p: Wǒ gānxīn wèi nǐ zuò rènhé shì.
甘心.e: I am ready to do anything for you.

留心.s: 我们要回去啦，你托我们的事情一定留心着。
留心.p: Wǒmen yào huíqu lā, nǐ tuō wǒmen de shìqing yídìng liúxīn zhe.
留心.e: We're heading back. We'll make sure to take care of what you asked us to do.

秘方.s: 青蛙和我轮流猜了秘方是什么。
秘方.p: Qīngwā hé wǒ lúnliú cāi le mìfāng shì shénme.
秘方.e: The frog and I took turns guessing what the secret recipe was.

乌云.e: The sky is covered in black clouds.

床位.s: 玛丽在她的床位上读书。
床位.p: Mǎlì zài tā de chuángwèi shàng dúshū.
床位.e: Mary is on her bunk reading.

药方.p: Wǒ huì gěi nǐ kāi gè yàofāng.

小丑.e: The clown made a funny face.

扑克.e: He knows how to play poker.

柱子.s: 巨大的柱子遮住了视线，让人看不到湖。
柱子.p: Jùdà de zhùzi zhēzhù le shìxiàn, ràng rén kàn búdào hú.
柱子.e: A large pillar obstructs the view of the lake.

礼堂.s: 会议将会在特意安排的礼堂里举行。
礼堂.p: Huìyì jiānghuì zài tèyì ānpái de lǐtáng lǐ jǔxíng.
礼堂.e: The conference will be held in a specially selected church.

海运.e: Do you like to send it by air mail or by surface mail?

稀有.s: 该国严禁进口稀有野生动物。
稀有.p: Gāi guó yánjìn jìnkǒu xīyǒu yěshēngdòngwù.
稀有.e: The importation of rare wild animals to this country is strictly prohibited.

供奉.s: 您知道这座庙宇供奉的是哪个神吗？
供奉.p: Nín zhīdào zhè zuò miàoyǔ gòngfèng de shì nǎge shén ma?
供奉.e: Do you know which deity this temple is dedicated to?

凉爽.e: The weather is quite pleasantly cool.

疙瘩.s: 他的鼻子上长了一个小疙瘩。
疙瘩.p: Tā de bízi shàng cháng le yìge xiǎo gēda.
疙瘩.e: On his nose grew a small pimple.

爱戴.e: He is loved by his people.

含糊.s: 你为什么这么含糊其辞？
含糊.p: Nǐ wèishénme zhème hánhu qí cí?
含糊.e: Why are you being so evasive?

翻新.s: 我们的场地不久前翻新了。
翻新.p: Wǒmen de chǎngdì bùjiǔqián fānxīn le.
翻新.e: Our venue wasn't renovated too long ago.

透气.s: 我想尽快从这个不透气的屋子里出去。
透气.p: Wǒ xiǎng jǐnkuài cóng zhège bútòuqì de wūzi lǐ chūqù.
透气.e: I want to move out of this cramped room as soon as I can.

健美.s: 她每星期去作一次健美操。
健美.p: Tā měi xīngqī qù zuò yícì jiànměicāo.
健美.e: She goes to aerobics once a week.

香料.s: 这块肥皂里添加了天然香料。
香料.p: Zhè kuài féizào lǐ tiānjiā le tiānrán xiāngliào.
香料.e: This soap is infused with natural fragrances.

搁浅.s: 一条受伤的鲸鱼在海滩边搁浅了。
搁浅.p: Yì tiáo shòushāng de jīngyú zài hǎitān biān gēqiǎn le.
搁浅.e: A wounded whale washed up on the beach.

对岸.p: Tā de jiā zài hé duìàn.
对岸.e: Her house is across the river.

锄.p: Huà chú wèi jiàn, huà jiàn wèi chú.
锄.e: Make the hoe your sword, and the sword your hoe.

奥秘.p: Shéi néng jiēkāi hǎiyáng de àomì?
奥秘.e: Who shall ever unravel the mysteries of the sea?

没完没了.s: 我受不了她没完没了的爱。
没完没了.p: Wǒ shòubùliǎo tā méiwánméiliǎo de ài.
没完没了.e: I cannot bear her endless love.

红润.s: 我所爱的是白皙红润，千里挑一的。
红润.p: Wǒ suǒ ài de shì báixī hóngrùn, qiānlǐ tiāo yì de.
红润.e: My beloved is white and ruddy, chosen out of thousands.

冰雹.s: 你什么时候看见过冰雹吗？
冰雹.p: Nǐ shénmeshíhou kànjiàn guò bīngbáo ma?
冰雹.e: Have you ever seen it hail?

费劲.s: 我毫不费劲就找到他的公司。
费劲.p: Wǒ háobú fèijìn jiù zhǎodào tā de gōngsī.
费劲.e: I had no trouble finding his office.

循序渐进.s: 学习是一个循序渐进的过程。
循序渐进.p: Xuéxí shì yìge xúnxùjiànjìn de guòchéng.

嗅.p: Xīn yǒu měnghǔ, xì xiù qiángwēi.
嗅.e: In me the tiger sniffs the rose.

吹牛.e: He likes to throw the bull.

嗜好.p: Huábīng shì wǒ de shìhào zhīyī.
嗜好.e: Skating is one of my hobbies.

能人.p: Wǒ zhīdào tā shì gè néngrén.
能人.e: I see that he is an able man.

集市.s: 所有人都去哪儿了？有集市吗？
集市.p: Suǒyǒurén dōu qù nǎr le? Yǒu jíshì ma?
集市.e: Where are all the people going? Is there a fair?

芬芳.s: 玫瑰的芬芳弥漫了整个房间.
芬芳.p: Méiguī de fēnfāng mímàn le zhěnggè fángjiān.
芬芳.e: The smell of roses filled the room.

没劲.s: 不是瞎说，我这份工作真是没劲！
没劲.p: Búshì xiāshuō, wǒ zhè fèn gōngzuò zhēnshi méijìn!
没劲.e: Do not talk nonsense, My job is very boring!

烟囱.p: Yān cóng yāncōng lǐ mào le chūlái.
烟囱.e: The smoke went upward through the chimney.

稚嫩.s: “以前网络好稚嫩啊，是吧？”“不，并没有。”
稚嫩.p: "Yǐqián wǎngluò hǎo zhìnèn a, shì ba?""Bú, bìng méiyǒu."
稚嫩.e: "The Internet was so innocent back then, wasn't it?" "No, it wasn't."

磁带.s: 他把他的那段话从磁带里删除了。
磁带.p: Tā bǎ tā de nà duàn huà cóng cídài lǐ shānchú le.
磁带.e: He erased his speech from the tape.

一无所知.s: 我对这个计划一无所知。
一无所知.e: I am quite ignorant of the plan.

争辩.p: Hé tā zhēngbiàn shì méiyòng de.
争辩.e: It is no use arguing with her.

厌烦.p: Tā yànfán le tā de gōngzuò.
厌烦.e: He was sick of his job.

蜜月.s: 我们想在澳大利亚过蜜月。
蜜月.p: Wǒmen xiǎng zài Àodàlìyà guò mìyuè.
蜜月.e: We want to spend our honeymoon in Australia.

草丛.p: Wǒ duǒ zài gāo cǎocóng lǐ le.
草丛.e: I hid in the tall grass.

肤浅.s: 他思想肤浅，这个我们知道就好。
肤浅.p: Tā sīxiǎng fūqiǎn, zhège wǒmen zhīdào jiù hǎo.
肤浅.e: Between you and me, he's a shallow thinker.

发芽.e: What should one do with germinating garlic bulbs?

闷热.s: 夏天总是闷热而又潮湿。
闷热.p: Xiàtiān zǒngshì mēnrè ér yòu cháoshī.
闷热.e: Summer is always hot and humid.

风趣.s: “她又有魅力又风趣！” “那她会做饭吗？” “谁在乎？”
风趣.p: "Tā yòu yǒumèilì yòu fēngqù!" "Nà tā huì zuòfàn ma?" "Shéi zàihu?"
风趣.e: "She's not only beautiful but also humorous." "Can she cook?" "Who cares?"

着迷.p: Fānyì de tiǎozhàn ràng wǒ zháomí.
着迷.e: I'm captivated by the challenges of translation.

韧性.p: Wǒ píng rènxìng kèfú le kùnnan.
韧性.e: I got over the difficulty with my characteristic tenacity.

恰巧.p: Tā qiàqiǎo zhīdào tā de dìzhǐ.

免职.e: That person needs to be relieved from his post.

猎物.p: Shīzi zài gēnzōng tā de lièwù.
猎物.e: The lion is stalking its prey.

无话可说.p: Yǐ wǒ zhī jiàn, wǒ wúhuàkěshuō.
无话可说.e: As for me, I have nothing to say.

稻草.s: 放轻松，这只是个稻草人而已。

公立.e: Many public school cafeterias are unscrupulous.

气馁.p: Mǎlì gàosù wǒ tā bú qìněi.
气馁.e: Mary told me she wasn't discouraged.

有朝一日.s: 我希望有朝一日去日本。
有朝一日.e: I want to go to Japan someday.

记号.p: Nǐ bù dǒng de cí zuò gè jìhao.
记号.e: Mark the words that you cannot understand.

纽扣.p: Nǐ chènyī de niǔkòu kuài diào le.
纽扣.e: Your shirt button is coming off.

笛子.s: 钢琴是和弦乐器，笛子是单音乐器。
笛子.p: Gāngqín shì héxián yuèqì, dízi shì dān yīnyuè qì.
笛子.e: The piano is a chord instrument, while the flute is a monophonic instrument.

谎话.p: Wǒ xīwàng nǐ búyào jiǎng huǎnghuà.
谎话.e: I hope you stop telling me lies.

斟酌.s: 我想花点时间斟酌斟酌再作决定。
斟酌.p: Wǒ xiǎng huā diǎn shíjiān zhēnzhuó zhēnzhuó zài zuò juédìng.
斟酌.e: I'd like some time to consider before I make a decision.

伯父.p: Wǒ zhù zài wǒ de bófù jiā.
伯父.e: I live in my uncle's house.

交响乐.s: 你知道伦敦交响乐团的演奏会行程吗？
交响乐.p: Nǐ zhīdào Lúndūn jiāoxiǎngyuètuán de yǎnzòu huì xíngchéng ma?
交响乐.e: Do you know the concert schedule of London Symphony Orchestra?

冒犯.p: Wǒ pà wǒ màofàn le nǐ.

寓言.s: 画龙点睛是一则寓言故事。
寓言.e: "Drawing dragons and dotting in the eyes" is a fable.

遛.s: 你可以骑上我的摩托车去遛一圈。
遛.p: Nǐ kěyǐ qí shàng wǒ de mótuōchē qù liù yì quān.
遛.e: You can have a ride on my motorcycle.

礼节.s: 我们老师确实很讲究礼节，不是吗？
礼节.p: Wǒmen lǎoshī quèshí hěn jiǎngjiu lǐjié, búshìma?
礼节.e: Our teacher really stands on ceremony, doesn't she?

俗语.s: 你中文真好，都能引用俗语了。
俗语.p: Nǐ Zhōngwén zhēn hǎo, dōu néng yǐnyòng súyǔ le.
俗语.e: Your Chinese is so good, you can quote proverbs.

姑且.s: 我们姑且认为它是对的。
姑且.p: Wǒmen gūqiě rènwéi tā shì duì de.
姑且.e: Let's assume this is correct for now.

羞耻.s: 他为他的失败感到羞耻。
羞耻.p: Tā wèi tā de shībài gǎndào xiūchǐ.
羞耻.e: He is ashamed of his failure.

物美价廉.e: The house looked good; moreover, the price was right.

诬陷.e: He was framed by his wife.

失礼.e: It is rude of you to say so.

消沉.s: 我一整天都觉得很消沉。
消沉.p: Wǒ yì zhěngtiān dōu juéde hěn xiāochén.
消沉.e: I was feeling blue all day.

拄.s: 自从我弄断了两条腿，我就拄着拐杖走路了。
拄.p: Zìcóng wǒ nòng duàn le liǎng tiáo tuǐ, wǒ jiù zhǔ zhe guǎizhàng zǒulù le.
拄.e: I'm on crutches since I broke both my legs.

因人而异.e: Opinions vary from person to person.

惊慌失措.e: Last night, I fell into a panic.

情理.e: What he says is total nonsense.

失传.s: 几近失传的中华礼仪用语。
失传.p: Jījìn shīchuán de Zhōnghuá lǐyí yòngyǔ.

知足常乐.e: Happy is the man who is contented.

恩人.p: Nǐ shì wǒ de jiùmìng ēnrén.

瘟疫.s: 成千上万的人死于瘟疫。
瘟疫.p: Chéngqiānshàngwàn de rén sǐ yú wēnyì.
瘟疫.e: Thousands upon thousands have died from the epidemic.

夜校.s: 她在夜校上自卫术课程。
夜校.p: Tā zài yèxiào shàng zìwèi shù kèchéng.
夜校.e: She took night classes in the art of self-defense.

斑马线.s: 红绿灯变红的时候，我刚好在斑马线上滑倒了。
斑马线.p: Hónglǜdēng biànhóng de shíhou, wǒ gānghǎo zài bānmǎxiàn shàng huádǎo le.
斑马线.e: I slipped and fell on the crosswalk, just when the light turned red.

拜会.s: 他前天拜会了法国总统。
拜会.p: Tā qiántiān bàihuì le Fǎguó zǒngtǒng.
拜会.e: He made an official visit to the French president the day before yesterday.

避暑.e: They went to Edinburgh to escape from the summer heat.

铺路.e: One generation builds the street that the next will travel on.

预兆.s: 他的懒惰是他未来不好的预兆。
预兆.p: Tā de lǎnduò shì tā wèilái bùhǎo de yùzhào.
预兆.e: His laziness boded ill for the future.

毯子.p: Wǒmen xiǎngyào yì tiáo xīn tǎnzi.

出神.s: 如果世界上没有神，那么我就用双手创造出神。
出神.p: Rúguǒ shìjiè shàng méiyǒu shén, nàme wǒ jiù yòng shuāngshǒu chuàngzào chūshén.
出神.e: If God doesn't exist in our world, then I will create God with my own hands.

堤坝.s: 堤坝保护了城市免受洪灾。
堤坝.p: Dībà bǎohù le chéngshì miǎnshòu hóngzāi.
堤坝.e: The bank secured the city from a flood.

走投无路.s: 我们被逼得走投无路了。
走投无路.p: Wǒmen bèi bī de zǒutóuwúlù le.
走投无路.e: We were driven to the wall.

会意.p: Yǒu yì tiān nǐ huìyì shí dào tā.
会意.e: The day will come when you will realize it.

鲁莽.s: 她比较鲁莽的相信了他。
鲁莽.p: Tā bǐjiào lǔmǎng de xiāngxìn le tā.
鲁莽.e: It was reckless of her to trust him.

赤道.s: 赤道把地球分为两个半球。
赤道.p: Chìdào bǎ dìqiú fēnwéi liǎng gè bànqiú.
赤道.e: The equator divides the globe into two hemispheres.

梳子.p: Wǒ de shūzi zài nǎlǐ ne?

累赘.s: 我知道自己是个累赘，你没必要反复提。
累赘.p: Wǒ zhīdào zìjǐ shì gè léizhuì, nǐ méi bìyào fǎnfù tí.
累赘.e: I know I'm a burden; you don't have to repeat it.

公事.s: 这样讯问只是警察例行公事。
公事.e: Such questioning is routine police business.

遭殃.s: 先下手为强，后下手遭殃。
遭殃.e: Get them before they get us.

大同小异.s: 如果你理解这一个,其它的也大同小异。
大同小异.p: Rúguǒ nǐ lǐjiě zhè yìge, qítā de yě dàtóngxiǎoyì.
大同小异.e: If you understand this one, then the others are nearly the same.

顺延.s: 如果那天下雨，比赛会顺延至下一个晴天。
顺延.p: Rúguǒ nàtiān xiàyǔ, bǐsài huì shùnyán zhì xiàyìge qíngtiān.
顺延.e: If it rains on that day, the game will be postponed until the next fine day.

诡计.s: 老的犬可以学新的诡计。
诡计.p: Lǎo de quǎn kěyǐ xué xīn de guǐjì.
诡计.e: Old dogs can learn new tricks.

水汽.p: Yún shì tiānkōng zhòngdì shuǐqì tuán.
水汽.e: A cloud is a mass of vapor in the sky.

郊游.e: I want to have a picnic.

绊.s: 要不是被绊了一下，我原本能赢的。
绊.p: Yàobúshì bèi bàn le yíxià, wǒ yuánběn néng yíng de.
绊.e: I would've won if I hadn't tripped.

不假思索.s: 汤姆不假思索脱口而出。

括号.s: 你应该把这句话放进括号。
括号.p: Nǐ yīnggāi bǎ zhè jù huà fàngjìn kuòhào.
括号.e: You should put this phrase in parentheses.

垫子.s: 进家门后，我被垫子绊倒了。
垫子.p: Jìn jiāmén hòu, wǒ bèi diànzi bàndǎo le.
垫子.e: Entering the house, I tripped over the mat.

说情.s: 他们说情况只是暂时的。
说情.p: Tāmen shuōqíng kuàng zhǐshì zànshí de.
说情.e: They said the situation was only temporary.

圣贤.p: Rén fēi shèngxián, shú néng wú guò.

嘲弄.e: You ought not to make fun of them.

美中不足.s: 唯一美中不足的是如果它要是熟食就好了。
美中不足.p: Wéiyì měizhōngbùzú de shì rúguǒ tā yàoshi shúshí jiù hǎo le.
美中不足.e: The only thing that would have made it better is if it was cooked.

挖苦.p: Nǐ zǒngshì wākǔ wǒ de zhuózhuāng.
挖苦.e: You are always digging at me about my clothes.

盛情.s: 照这样的情况，很抱歉，我不能接受你的盛情邀请。
盛情.p: Zhào zhèyàng de qíngkuàng, hěn bàoqiàn, wǒ bùnéng jiēshòu nǐ de shèngqíng yāoqǐng.
盛情.e: As such is the case, I am sorry I can't accept your kind invitation.

冗长.s: 这位老教授的讲座冗长而沉闷。
冗长.p: Zhèwèi lǎo jiāoshòu de jiǎngzuò rǒngcháng ér chénmèn.
冗长.e: The old professor's lectures are long-winded and ponderous.

褒贬.s: 影片得到的评价褒贬不一。
褒贬.p: Yǐngpiàn dédào de píngjià bāobiǎn bùyī.

指手画脚.s: 不要让她对你指手画脚。
指手画脚.p: Búyào ràng tā duì nǐ zhǐshǒuhuàjiǎo.
指手画脚.e: Don't let yourself be bossed around by her.

解渴.s: 你有没有什么喝的给我解渴吗？
解渴.p: Nǐ yǒuméiyǒu shénme hē de gěi wǒ jiěkě ma?
解渴.e: Do you have a drink to help quench my thirst?

难为情.s: 他太难为情，在大众人前一句话也说不出来。
难为情.p: Tā tài nánwéiqíng, zài dàzhòng rén qián yíjùhuà yě shuōbùchū lái.
难为情.e: He was too embarrassed to utter a word in front of the crowd.

袖手旁观.s: 你要是不答应的话，我就袖手旁观。
袖手旁观.p: Nǐ yàoshi bù dāying dehuà, wǒ jiù xiùshǒupángguān.
袖手旁观.e: If you don't make the promise, then I'll just stand by and watch.

标点.s: 他们说的话，我连标点符号都不信。
标点.p: Tāmen shuō dehuà, wǒ lián biāodiǎnfúhào dōu bú xìn.
标点.e: I do not trust a single word that comes out of their mouths.

领事馆.s: 在法国，你在大使馆工作还是领事馆？
领事馆.p: Zài Fǎguó, nǐ zài dàshǐguǎn gōngzuò háishi lǐngshìguǎn?
领事馆.e: In France did you work at the embassy or in the consulate?

年轮.s: 科学家研究了树木年轮的数据。
年轮.p: Kēxuéjiā yánjiū le shùmù niánlún de shùjù.
年轮.e: The scientists looked at tree-ring data.

半途而废.e: You shouldn't do things by halves.

面红耳赤.s: 这两个人因意见不合，而争得面红耳赤不欢而散。
面红耳赤.p: Zhè liǎng gèrén yīn yìjiànbùhé, ér zhēngdé miànhóngěrchì bùhuānérsàn.
面红耳赤.e: Due to differing opinions between the two, they argued angrily, before leaving unhappily.

隐情.e: There must be something at the back of this matter.

晕头转向.e: I’ve been absolutely off my feet lately.

阴历.e: In China, they celebrate New Year by the lunar calendar.

彬彬有礼.s: 汤姆既彬彬有礼又善解人意。

稠密.s: 西里西亚省是波兰人口稠密度最大的地区。
稠密.p: Xīlǐxīyà shěng shì Bōlán rénkǒuchóumì dù zuì dà de dìqū.
稠密.e: The Silesian Voivodeship is the most densely populated region of Poland.

露营.s: 汤姆没有喜欢露营的朋友。
露营.p: Tāngmǔ méiyǒu xǐhuan lùyíng de péngyou.
露营.e: Tom doesn't have any friends who like camping.

饶恕.e: The princess begged forgiveness from the emperor.

打搅.s: 汤姆已经被告知别再打搅玛丽了。
打搅.p: Tāngmǔ yǐjīng bèigào zhī bié zài dǎjiǎo Mǎlì le.
打搅.e: Tom has already been told to leave Mary alone.

恳切.s: 尽管我恳切地要求，他们还是拒绝跟我说话。
恳切.p: Jǐnguǎn wǒ kěnqiè de yāoqiú, tāmen háishi jùjué gēn wǒ shuōhuà.
恳切.e: They refused to talk to me in spite of my earnest request.

帘子.e: Who is hiding behind the curtain?

繁体字.e: This is in Traditional Chinese characters.

取决.s: 你所说的话取决于你的本意。
取决.p: Nǐ suǒ shuō dehuà qǔjuéyú nǐ de běnyì.
取决.e: The word you use depends on your intended meaning.

前无古人.s: 他是一位前无古人的大科学家。
前无古人.p: Tā shì yí wèi qiánwúgǔrén de dà kēxuéjiā.
前无古人.e: He is as great a scientist as ever lived.

狼吞虎咽.s: 他狼吞虎咽地吃了食物。
狼吞虎咽.p: Tā lángtūnhǔyàn de chī le shíwù.

沏.p: Tā gěi wǒ qī le chá.

川流不息.s: 移民川流不息地进入这个国家。
川流不息.p: Yímín chuānliúbùxī de jìnrù zhège guójiā.
川流不息.e: The immigrants entered the country in a steady flow.

胆小鬼.e: He is afraid of his own shadow.

画龙点睛.s: 我将增加画龙点睛的功能。
画龙点睛.p: Wǒ jiàng zēngjiā huàlóngdiǎnjīng de gōngnéng.

精疲力竭.s: 你精疲力竭的面孔有时会出现在我眼前。
精疲力竭.p: Nǐ jīngpílìjié de miànkǒng yǒushí huì chūxiàn zài wǒ yǎnqián.
精疲力竭.e: Sometimes that tired-out face of yours appears in front of my eyes.

阅览.s: 日内瓦大学有一间很好的阅览室。
阅览.p: Rìnèiwǎ dàxué yǒu yì jiān hěn hǎo de yuèlǎnshì.
阅览.e: The Geneva University Library has a good reading room.

捉迷藏.e: Let's play a game of blind man's buff.

大公无私.s: 我对她的大公无私怀有敬意。
大公无私.p: Wǒ duì tā de dàgōngwúsī huáiyǒu jìngyì.

蛀牙.e: I have a lot of bad teeth.

野餐.e: They set out on a picnic.

请帖.p: Wǒ shōudào le yì zhāng qǐngtiě.

哄堂大笑.e: The whole audience erupted in laughter.

粗心大意.s: 他们粗心大意，还没意识到危险。
粗心大意.p: Tāmen cūxīndàyì, hái méi yìshídào wēixiǎn.
粗心大意.e: They were carelessly unaware of the danger.

钻空子.s: 我们不能让对方钻空子。
钻空子.e: We can't leave the counterparty any loopholes.

柏树.s: 这片森林的树主要是柏树。
柏树.p: Zhè piàn sēnlín de shù zhǔyào shì bǎishù.
柏树.e: The main type of tree in this part of the forest is the cypress.

三番五次.e: He judges other people time and again.

瑞雪.e: A timely snow promises a good harvest.

南辕北辙.e: You're not going in the right direction.

迭起.s: 惠子巧妙地把碗碟迭起再拿到水槽。
迭起.p: Huìzi qiǎomiào de bǎ wǎn dié diéqǐ zài nádào shuǐcáo.
迭起.e: Keiko deftly piles up the dishes and takes them to the sink.

部首.e: The radical in the Chinese character for "good" is the character for "woman".

井底之蛙.e: He is like a frog in a well.

东奔西走.s: 长年累月东奔西走忙死了，生活太没有规律了。
东奔西走.p: Chángniánlěiyuè dōngbēnxīzǒu máng sǐ le, shēnghuó tài méiyǒu guīlǜ le.
东奔西走.e: I'm so busy running about year in, year out. My life has no consistency.

劳驾.p: Kěfǒu láojià nǐ bāng wǒ gè máng?
劳驾.e: Could you please do me a favor?

水滴石穿.e: Constant dripping wears away a stone.

出任.s: 我希望你没出任何问题。
出任.p: Wǒ xīwàng nǐ méi chūrèn hé wèntí.
出任.e: I hope you did not have any problem.

大数据.s: 听说大数据技术现在很热门。
大数据.p: Tīngshuō dàshùjù jìshù xiànzài hěn rèmén.
大数据.e: I hear that the network is very popular now.

地势.s: 天行健，君子以自强不息；地势坤，君子以厚德载物。
地势.p: Tiān xíng jiàn, jūnzǐ yǐ zìqiángbùxī; dìshì kūn, jūnzǐ yǐ hòudézàiwù.
地势.e: As heaven maintains its vigorous motion, the noble person should strive for continuous self-improvement. As the earth's nature is receptive and nurturing, the noble person should cultivate great virtue to support and carry all things.

富含.s: 水果富含维生素和矿物质。
富含.e: Fruits are rich in vitamins and minerals.

孤单.s: 一本好书在手，我们不必孤单。
孤单.p: Yì běn hǎo shū zài shǒu, wǒmen búbì gūdān.
孤单.e: With a good book in your hands you need never feel lonely.

孤立.s: 好几间小屋被洪水孤立起来了。
孤立.p: Hǎojǐ jiān xiǎowū bèi hóngshuǐ gūlì qǐlai le.
孤立.e: Several cottages have been isolated by the flood water.

黑客.s: 很多人无法理解黑客们的行为。
黑客.p: Hěn duō rén wúfǎ lǐjiě hēikè men de xíngwéi.
黑客.e: Many people cannot understand the way hackers behave.

奖项.p: Jiǎngxiàng shì búhuì shòu gěi tā de.
奖项.e: The prize won't be given to her.

人气.s: 这部电影为她赢得了人气。
人气.p: Zhè bù diànyǐng wèi tā yíngdé le rénqì.
人气.e: The movie gained her great popularity.

身子.s: 那就不要光着身子散步!
身子.p: Nà jiù búyào guāng zhe shēnzi sànbù!
身子.e: Don't go for a walk naked!

时好时坏.s: 我父亲的状况时好时坏。
时好时坏.e: My father's condition seems to improve one moment, but the next moment he sinks again.

唯独.s: 快乐存在于过去和未来，唯独不存在于现在。
唯独.p: Kuàilè cúnzài yú guòqù hé wèilái, wéidú bù cúnzài yú xiànzài.
唯独.e: Pleasure is always in the past or in the future, never in the present.

效力.s: 这份合同没有法律效力。
效力.p: Zhè fèn hétong méiyǒufǎ lǜ xiàolì.
效力.e: This contract is null and void.

昔日.s: 这些照片总是让我想起昔日时光。
昔日.p: Zhèxiē zhàopiàn zǒngshì ràng wǒ xiǎngqǐ xīrì shíguāng.
昔日.e: These pictures always remind me of the old days.

与否.s: 你成功与否取决于你自身的努力。
与否.p: Nǐ chénggōng yǔfǒu qǔjuéyú nǐ zìshēn de nǔlì.
与否.e: Whether you succeed or not depends on your own efforts.

与时俱进.e: Language keeps in step with the times.

诸位.s: 请诸位斟满酒，为新郎和新娘干杯！
诸位.p: Qǐng zhūwèi zhēn mǎn jiǔ, wèi xīnláng hé xīnniáng gānbēi!
诸位.e: Please charge your glasses and drink a toast to the bride and groom!

主页.s: 这些新模块毫无疑问会影响主页的加载速度。
主页.p: Zhèxiē xīn mókuài háowúyíwèn huì yǐngxiǎng zhǔyè de jiāzài sùdù.
主页.e: All these new blocks will undoubtedly impact the loading speed of the home page.

作客.s: 昨天，我去我叔叔家作客。
作客.p: Zuótiān, wǒqù wǒ shūshu jiā zuòkè.
作客.e: I called at my uncle's house yesterday.
